verses.1:1: The words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, from the priests who were in Anathoth, in the land of Benjamin,
verses.1:2: to whom the word of the LORD came during the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.1:3: It also came during the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the completion of the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah, king of Judah, until Jerusalem went into exile in the fifth month.
verses.1:4: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.1:5: "Before I shaped you in the womb, I knew you, and before you came out from the womb, I set you apart as holy; a prophet to the nations I have appointed you."
verses.1:6: And I said, "Ah, Lord GOD! Look, I do not know how to speak, for I am a youth."
verses.1:7: But the LORD said to me, "Do not say, 'I am a youth,' for to whomever I send you, you will go, and everything that I command you, you will speak.
verses.1:8: Do not be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you, declares the LORD."
verses.1:9: Then the LORD reached out His hand and touched my mouth. And the LORD said to me, "Look, I have placed My words in your mouth.
verses.1:10: See, I have commissioned you this day over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to break down, to destroy and to demolish, to build and to plant."
verses.1:11: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying, "What are you seeing, Jeremiah?" And I said, "I see a branch of an almond tree."
verses.1:12: And the LORD said to me, "You have seen well, for I am keeping watch over My word to carry it out."
verses.1:13: And the word of the LORD came to me a second time, saying, "What are you seeing?" And I said, "I see a boiling pot, and its face is away from the north."
verses.1:14: And the LORD said to me, "From the north the disaster will break open upon all the inhabitants of the land.
verses.1:15: For look, I am summoning all the clans of the kingdoms of the north, declares the LORD. And they will come, and each one will place his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all her walls all around, and against all the cities of Judah.
verses.1:16: And I will speak My judgments against them for all their wickedness, because they have forsaken Me, and burned incense to other gods, and bowed down to the works of their hands.
verses.1:17: But as for you, gird your waist, and arise and speak to them everything that I command you. Do not be terrified because of them, or else I will terrify you before them.
verses.1:18: And as for Me, look, I have made you today a fortified city, and an iron pillar, and walls of bronze against the entire land: against the kings of Judah, against her officials, against her priests, and against the people of the land.
verses.1:19: And they will fight against you, yet they will not prevail over you, for I am with you, declares the LORD, to rescue you."
verses.2:2: "Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, 'This is what the LORD says: I remember for you the loyal love of your youth, the love of your bridal days, your walking after Me in the wilderness, in a land not sown.
verses.2:3: Holy was Israel to the LORD, the firstfruits of His produce; all who devoured him became guilty; disaster came upon them, declares the LORD.'"
verses.2:4: Listen to the word of the LORD, house of Jacob, and all the clans of the house of Israel.
verses.2:5: This is what the LORD says: "What wrong did your fathers find in Me, that they withdrew far from Me, and walked after futility and became futile?
verses.2:6: And they did not say, 'Where is the LORD, who brought us up from the land of Egypt, who led us in the wilderness, in a land of desert plain and pits, in a land of drought and deep gloom, in a land through which no man passed, and where no human dwelt?'
verses.2:7: And I brought you into the fertile land to eat its fruit and its bounty. Yet you came in and defiled My land, and My inheritance you turned into an abomination.
verses.2:8: The priests did not say, 'Where is the LORD?' And those who hold the law did not know Me, and the shepherds rebelled against Me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal and walked after things that do not benefit.
verses.2:9: Therefore I will contend with you further, declares the LORD, and with the children of your children I will contend.
verses.2:10: For cross over to the coastlands of Kittim and see, and send to Kedar and examine closely, and see whether anything like this has happened.
verses.2:11: Has a nation exchanged gods, even though they are not gods? Yet My people have exchanged their glory for what does not benefit.
verses.2:12: Be appalled at this, heavens, and shudder, be completely desolate, declares the LORD.
verses.2:13: For My people have done two evils: Me they have forsaken, the spring of living water, to carve out cisterns for themselves, broken cisterns that cannot contain water.
verses.2:14: Is Israel a slave, or is he one born in the household? Why has he become plunder?
verses.2:15: Young lions have roared against him; they have lifted up their voice. And they have turned his land into a desolation; his cities have been burned, with no inhabitant.
verses.2:16: Also the sons of Noph and Tahpanhes have grazed bare the crown of your head.
verses.2:17: Has not your forsaking the LORD your God done this to you, at the time He was leading you along the way?
verses.2:18: And now, what business do you have on the way to Egypt, to drink the waters of Shihor? And what business do you have on the way to Assyria, to drink the waters of the River?
verses.2:19: Your wickedness will discipline you, and your apostasies will rebuke you. Know and see that your forsaking the LORD your God is evil and bitter, and that the dread of Me is not in you, declares the Lord GOD of hosts.
verses.2:20: For long ago I broke your yoke and snapped your bonds, and you said, 'I will not transgress'; yet upon every high hill and under every luxuriant tree you lie down as a prostitute.
verses.2:21: Yet I planted you as a choice vine, all of it genuine seed. How then have you turned before Me into degenerate shoots of a foreign vine?
verses.2:22: For even if you wash with lye and multiply soap for yourself, your iniquity remains stained before Me, declares the Lord GOD.
verses.2:23: How can you say, 'I have not been defiled; I have not walked after the Baals'? Look at your way in the valley; know what you have done: a swift young female camel interlacing her ways,
verses.2:24: a wild donkey accustomed to the wilderness; in the craving of her soul she sniffs the wind. Her mating urge, who can turn it back? All who seek her will not grow weary; in her month they will find her.
verses.2:25: Hold back your foot from going barefoot and your throat from thirst. Yet you said, 'It is hopeless! No! For I love strangers, and after them I will go.'
verses.2:26: Like the shame of a thief when he is found out, so the house of Israel is put to shame: they, their kings, their officials, their priests, and their prophets,
verses.2:27: saying to a tree, 'You are my father,' and to a stone, 'You gave birth to us.' For they have turned the back of their neck to Me, and not their face; yet in the time of their disaster they will say, 'Arise and save us!'
verses.2:28: And where are your gods that you made for yourself? Let them arise, if they can save you in the time of your disaster; for your gods have become as many as the number of your cities, Judah.
verses.2:29: Why do you contend against Me? All of you have rebelled against Me, declares the LORD.
verses.2:30: In vain I struck your children; they did not accept discipline. Your sword devoured your prophets like a destroying lion.
verses.2:31: You, this generation, look at the word of the LORD! Have I been a wilderness to Israel, or a land of deepest darkness? Why have My people said, 'We roam freely; we will not come to You again'?
verses.2:32: Does a virgin forget her jewelry, or a bride her sashes? Yet My people have forgotten Me for days beyond number.
verses.2:33: How skillfully you set your way to seek love! Therefore you have taught your ways even to wicked women.
verses.2:34: Moreover, on the hems of your garments is found the blood of the lives of the innocent needy; you did not catch them breaking in. Yet despite all these things,
verses.2:35: you say, 'Indeed I am innocent; surely His anger has turned back from me.' Look, I am entering into judgment with you for your saying, 'I have not sinned.'
verses.2:36: How greatly you go about to alter your way! By Egypt as well you will be shamed, just as you were shamed by Assyria.
verses.2:37: From this one also you will go out with your hands upon your head, for the LORD has rejected the objects of your trust, and you will not succeed through them."
verses.3:1: Saying, "If a man sends away his wife, and she goes from him and becomes another man's, will he return to her again? Would not that land be utterly polluted? Yet you have played the prostitute with many lovers, and would you return to Me?" declares the LORD.
verses.3:2: "Lift up your eyes to the bare heights and see: where have you not been lain with? Along the roads you sat for them like an Arab in the wilderness, and you polluted the land with your acts of prostitution and with your evil.
verses.3:3: Therefore the showers were withheld, and there was no spring rain; yet you had the forehead of a prostitute; you refused to be ashamed.
verses.3:4: Have you not just now called to Me, 'My Father, You are the companion of my youth!
verses.3:5: Will He keep anger forever? Will He hold it to the end?' Look, you have spoken, yet you have done evil things and have had your way."
verses.3:6: Then the LORD said to me in the days of Josiah the king, "Have you seen what wayward Israel has done? She went up on every high mountain and under every lush tree, and she played the prostitute there.
verses.3:7: And I said, 'After she has done all these things, she will return to Me,' but she did not return. And her treacherous sister Judah saw it.
verses.3:8: And I saw that for all the occasions when wayward Israel committed adultery, I had sent her away and given her a certificate of her divorce; yet treacherous Judah, her sister, did not fear, but she went and played the prostitute as well.
verses.3:9: And it happened, because of the casualness of her prostitution, that she polluted the land and committed adultery with stone and with wood.
verses.3:10: Yet even in spite of all this, her treacherous sister Judah did not return to Me with all her heart, but only in falsehood," declares the LORD.
verses.3:11: And the LORD said to me, "Wayward Israel has proved herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.
verses.3:12: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, 'Return, wayward Israel, declares the LORD; I will not look angrily on you, for I am faithful, declares the LORD; I will not keep anger forever.
verses.3:13: Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have rebelled against the LORD your God and have scattered your ways to strangers under every lush tree, and you have not listened to My voice, declares the LORD.'"
verses.3:14: "Return, wayward sons," declares the LORD, "for I am a husband to you, and I will take you, one from a city and two from a clan, and bring you to Zion.
verses.3:15: And I will give you shepherds according to My own heart, and they will shepherd you with knowledge and insight.
verses.3:16: And it will be, when you multiply and are fruitful in the land in those days," declares the LORD, "that they will no longer say, 'The ark of the covenant of the LORD.' It will not come to mind, nor will they remember it, nor will they miss it, nor will it be made again.
verses.3:17: At that time they will call Jerusalem the throne of the LORD, and all the nations will be gathered to it, to the name of the LORD, to Jerusalem; and they will no longer walk after the stubbornness of their evil heart.
verses.3:18: In those days the house of Judah will go to the house of Israel, and they will come together from the land of the north to the land that I gave as an inheritance to your fathers."
verses.3:19: "I Myself said, 'How I would set you among the sons and give you a desirable land, the most splendid inheritance of the hosts of nations!' And I thought you would call Me 'My Father' and would not turn away from following Me.
verses.3:20: Surely, as a woman treacherously departs from her companion, so you have acted treacherously against Me, house of Israel," declares the LORD.
verses.3:21: A voice is heard on the bare heights, the weeping pleadings of the sons of Israel, because they have perverted their way; they have forgotten the LORD their God.
verses.3:22: "Return, wayward sons; I will heal your wayward ways." "Here we are, we come to You, for You are the LORD our God.
verses.3:23: Truly, from the hills comes falsehood, the tumult of the mountains; truly, in the LORD our God is the salvation of Israel.
verses.3:24: But the shameful thing has devoured the labor of our fathers since our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
verses.3:25: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our disgrace cover us; for we have sinned against the LORD our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day, and we have not listened to the voice of the LORD our God."
verses.4:1: "If you will return, Israel," declares the LORD, "then return to Me. And if you remove your detestable things from My presence and do not waver,
verses.4:2: and swear, 'As the LORD lives,' in truth, in justice, and in righteousness, then nations will bless themselves in Him, and in Him they will boast."
verses.4:3: For this is what the LORD says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem: "Break up fallow ground for yourselves, and do not sow among thorns.
verses.4:4: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD and remove the foreskins of your heart, men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem, or else My wrath will go out like fire and burn with no one to quench it, because of the evil of your deeds."
verses.4:5: "Declare in Judah and proclaim in Jerusalem, and say, 'Blow the trumpet in the land!' Cry out at full voice and say, 'Gather together, and let us go into the fortified cities!'
verses.4:6: Raise a signal toward Zion! Take refuge, do not stand still! For I am bringing disaster from the north, and great destruction."
verses.4:7: A lion has gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations has set out; he has gone out from his place to make your land a desolation; your cities will fall into ruins, without an inhabitant.
verses.4:8: Because of this, put on sackcloth, lament and wail, for the fierce anger of the LORD has not turned back from us.
verses.4:9: "And it will be on that day," declares the LORD, "that the heart of the king and the heart of the officials will fail, the priests will be appalled, and the prophets will be astounded."
verses.4:10: Then I said, "Ah, Lord GOD! Surely You have utterly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, 'You will have peace,' whereas the sword has reached to the throat!"
verses.4:11: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, "A scorching wind from the bare heights in the wilderness toward the daughter of My people, not to winnow and not to cleanse,
verses.4:12: a wind too strong for these comes for Me. Now I too will pronounce judgments against them."
verses.4:13: Look! Like clouds he comes up, and like the whirlwind are his chariots; his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us, for we are devastated!
verses.4:14: Wash your heart from evil, Jerusalem, so that you may be saved. How long will thoughts of your wickedness lodge within you?
verses.4:15: For a voice declares from Dan and proclaims calamity from the hill country of Ephraim.
verses.4:16: "Announce to the nations; look, proclaim against Jerusalem, 'Besiegers are coming from a distant land, and they raise their voice against the cities of Judah.'
verses.4:17: Like watchmen of a field they are against her all around, because she has rebelled against Me," declares the LORD.
verses.4:18: Your way and your deeds have done these things to you. This is your evil; truly it is bitter, truly it has reached to your heart.
verses.4:19: My inward parts, my inward parts! I writhe in pain! The walls of my heart! My heart is pounding within me; I cannot keep silent, for you have heard the sound of the trumpet, my soul, the alarm of war!
verses.4:20: Destruction upon destruction is reported, for the whole land is devastated; suddenly my tents are devastated, in an instant, my tent curtains.
verses.4:21: How long must I see the signal and hear the sound of the trumpet?
verses.4:22: "For My people are foolish; they do not know Me. They are senseless sons, and they are not discerning. They are wise to do evil, but they do not know how to do good."
verses.4:23: I looked at the earth, and see, it was unformed and empty; and to the heavens, and their light was gone.
verses.4:24: I looked at the mountains, and see, they were quaking, and all the hills shook to and fro.
verses.4:25: I looked, and see, there was no human being, and all the birds of the heavens had fled.
verses.4:26: I looked, and see, the fruitful land was a wilderness, and all its cities were torn down before the LORD, before His fierce anger.
verses.4:27: For this is what the LORD says, "The whole land will be a desolation, yet I will not make a complete end.
verses.4:28: Because of this the earth will mourn, and the heavens above will grow dark, because I have spoken, I have purposed, and I have not relented, nor will I turn back from it."
verses.4:29: At the sound of horsemen and archers, every city flees; they go into the thickets and climb up into the crags; every city is abandoned, and no one dwells in them.
verses.4:30: And you, devastated one, what will you do? Though you dress in scarlet, though you adorn yourself with ornaments of gold, though you enlarge your eyes with paint, in vain you beautify yourself. Lovers despise you; they seek your life.
verses.4:31: For I heard a cry like that of a woman in labor, anguish like that of a woman bearing her first child, the cry of the daughter of Zion, gasping for breath, stretching out her hands: "Woe to me now, for my soul faints before murderers!"
verses.5:1: Go back and forth through the streets of Jerusalem, and look now and know, and search in her plazas; if you find a man, if there is one who practices justice, who seeks faithfulness, then I will forgive her.
verses.5:2: Even though they say, "As the LORD lives," still they swear falsely.
verses.5:3: LORD, are Your eyes not on faithfulness? You struck them, yet they felt no pain; You consumed them, yet they refused to accept discipline. They hardened their faces more than rock; they refused to turn back.
verses.5:4: Then I said, "These are only the poor; they have acted foolishly, for they do not know the way of the LORD, the justice of their God.
verses.5:5: I will go to the great ones and speak with them, for they know the way of the LORD, the justice of their God." Yet they all together have broken the yoke; they have snapped the bonds.
verses.5:6: Therefore a lion from the forest will strike them, a wolf of the desert plains will devastate them, a leopard is keeping watch over their cities; everyone who goes out from them will be torn to pieces, because their transgressions are many, their apostasies are numerous.
verses.5:7: "How can I forgive you for this? Your sons have forsaken Me and sworn by those who are not gods. When I fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and they thronged to a prostitute's house.
verses.5:8: They have become well-fed, lusty stallions; each one neighs after his neighbor's wife.
verses.5:9: Shall I not punish for these things?" declares the LORD. "And on a nation such as this, shall My soul not take vengeance?
verses.5:10: Go up through her vine rows and destroy, yet do not make a complete end; strip away her tendrils, for they do not belong to the LORD.
verses.5:11: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt utterly treacherously with Me," declares the LORD.
verses.5:12: They have denied the LORD and said, "It is not He; no disaster will come upon us, nor will we see sword or famine.
verses.5:13: And the prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them; thus it shall be done to them."
verses.5:14: Therefore this is what the LORD, the God of hosts, says: "Because you have spoken this word, look, I am making My words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it will consume them.
verses.5:15: Look, I am bringing a nation upon you from afar, house of Israel," declares the LORD. "It is an enduring nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language you do not know, nor can you understand what it says.
verses.5:16: Its quiver is like an open grave; all of them are warriors.
verses.5:17: It will devour your harvest and your bread; they will devour your sons and your daughters; it will devour your flocks and your herds; it will devour your vines and your fig trees; it will demolish with the sword your fortified cities in which you trust.
verses.5:18: Yet even in those days," declares the LORD, "I will not make a complete end of you.
verses.5:19: And it will happen, when you say, 'Why has the LORD our God done all these things to us?' then you shall say to them, 'Just as you have forsaken Me and served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve strangers in a land that is not yours.'"
verses.5:20: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and proclaim it in Judah, saying:
verses.5:21: "Hear this now, foolish people without understanding: they have eyes, yet they do not see; they have ears, yet they do not hear.
verses.5:22: Do you not fear Me?" declares the LORD. "Will you not tremble in My presence, I who set the sand as a boundary for the sea, a perpetual decree that it cannot cross? Even when its waves surge, they cannot prevail; even when they roar, they cannot cross over it.
verses.5:23: Yet this people has an obstinate and rebellious heart; they have turned aside and walked away.
verses.5:24: They do not say in their heart, 'Let us now fear the LORD our God, who gives rain, early rain and late rain in its season, who preserves for us the fixed weeks of the harvest.'
verses.5:25: Your iniquities have turned these things away, and your sins have held back what is good from you.
verses.5:26: For wicked men are found among My people; they lie in wait as fowlers crouch; they set a trap; it is men they catch.
verses.5:27: Just as a cage is full of birds, so their houses are full of deceit; therefore they have grown great and become wealthy.
verses.5:28: They have grown fat, they have become sleek; they also go beyond all bounds in evil deeds. They do not judge the cause, the cause of the orphan, so that they may prosper, and they do not uphold the right of the needy.
verses.5:29: Shall I not punish for these things?" declares the LORD. "On a nation such as this, shall My soul not take vengeance?
verses.5:30: A shocking and ghastly thing has taken place in the land:
verses.5:31: the prophets prophesy with falsehood, and the priests govern at their direction, and My people love it that way. Yet what will you do at its end?"
verses.6:1: Flee for safety, sons of Benjamin, out of the midst of Jerusalem! In Tekoa blow the horn, and on Beth-hakkerem lift up a signal fire, for disaster looms from the north, and great destruction.
verses.6:2: The lovely and pampered one I will cut off, daughter of Zion.
verses.6:3: Shepherds and their flocks will come to her; they will pitch tents against her all around; each one will graze his own place.
verses.6:4: "Consecrate war against her! Rise up, and let us go up at noon!" "Woe to us, for the day has declined, for the shadows of evening stretch out!"
verses.6:5: "Rise up, and let us go up by night, and let us destroy her palaces!"
verses.6:6: For this is what the LORD of hosts says: "Cut down trees and heap up a siege ramp against Jerusalem. This is the city to be punished; all of her is oppression in her midst.
verses.6:7: Like a well keeping its waters fresh, so she keeps her wickedness fresh; violence and devastation are heard within her; before Me continually are sickness and wounds.
verses.6:8: Accept discipline, Jerusalem, or else My soul will be torn away from you, or else I will make you a desolation, an uninhabited land."
verses.6:9: This is what the LORD of hosts says: "They will thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like a vine; pass your hand back like a grape-gatherer over the branches."
verses.6:10: To whom shall I speak and give warning, that they may listen? Look, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot pay attention. Look, the word of the LORD has become a reproach to them; they take no delight in it.
verses.6:11: But I am full of the wrath of the LORD; I am weary of holding it in. "Pour it out on the child in the street, and on the gathering of young men together; for both husband and wife will be captured, the aged along with the one full of days.
verses.6:12: Their houses will be turned over to others, fields and wives together, for I will stretch out My hand against the inhabitants of the land," declares the LORD.
verses.6:13: "For from the least of them to the greatest of them, every one of them is greedy for unjust gain; and from prophet to priest, every one of them practices falsehood.
verses.6:14: And they heal the fracture of My people lightly, saying, 'Peace, peace,' yet there is no peace.
verses.6:15: They acted shamefully, for they committed an abomination; yet they were not ashamed at all, nor did they know how to blush. Therefore they will fall among those who fall; at the time I punish them they will stumble," says the LORD.
verses.6:16: This is what the LORD says: "Take your stand along the roads and look, and ask about the ancient pathways, which is the good way, and walk in it, and find rest for your souls. Yet they said, 'We will not walk in it.'
verses.6:17: And I raised up watchmen over you: 'Pay attention to the sound of the horn!' Yet they said, 'We will not pay attention.'
verses.6:18: Therefore hear, you nations, and know, congregation, what is among them.
verses.6:19: Hear, earth! Look, I am bringing disaster upon this people, the fruit of their schemes, because they have not paid attention to My words, and as for My law, they have rejected it.
verses.6:20: What is it to Me that frankincense comes from Sheba, and sweet cane from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices are not pleasing to Me."
verses.6:21: Therefore this is what the LORD says: "Look, I am placing stumbling blocks before this people, and fathers and sons together will stumble over them, neighbor and his companion, and they will perish."
verses.6:22: This is what the LORD says: "Look, a people is coming from the land of the north, and a great nation is being roused from the farthest reaches of the earth.
verses.6:23: They grasp bow and javelin; they are cruel and show no compassion; their voice roars like the sea, and upon horses they ride, arrayed like a man for battle against you, daughter of Zion."
verses.6:24: We have heard the report of it; our hands have grown limp; anguish has gripped us, pain like a woman giving birth.
verses.6:25: Do not go out into the field, and do not walk along the road, for the enemy has a sword; terror is on every side.
verses.6:26: Daughter of my people, put on sackcloth and roll in ashes; make mourning for yourself as for an only son, a bitter lamentation, for suddenly the devastator will come upon us.
verses.6:27: I have made you a tester among My people, a fortress, so that you may know and test their way.
verses.6:28: All of them are the most stubborn of rebels, going about with slander; they are bronze and iron; all of them act corruptly.
verses.6:29: The bellows are scorched; the lead is consumed by the fire. In vain the refining continues, yet the wicked are not separated.
verses.6:30: "Rejected silver," people call them, because the LORD has rejected them.
verses.7:2: "Stand in the gate of the house of the LORD and proclaim this word there, and say, 'Hear the word of the LORD, all Judah, who enter through these gates to bow down to the LORD.'"
verses.7:3: This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "Make your ways and your actions good, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
verses.7:4: Do not trust in words of falsehood, saying, 'The temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD are these.'
verses.7:5: For if you truly make your ways and your actions good, if you truly practice justice between a man and his neighbor,
verses.7:6: if you do not oppress the sojourner, the orphan, and the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and do not walk after other gods to your own harm,
verses.7:7: then I will cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers from ancient times and forever.
verses.7:8: Look, you are trusting in words of falsehood to no profit.
verses.7:9: Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods whom you have not known,
verses.7:10: and then come and stand before Me in this house over which My name is called, and say, 'We have been rescued,' in order to do all these abominations?
verses.7:11: Has this house, over which My name is called, become a cave of robbers in your eyes? Look, I Myself have seen it too," declares the LORD.
verses.7:12: "Indeed, go now to My place that was in Shiloh, where I caused My name to dwell at first, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of My people Israel.
verses.7:13: And now, because you have done all these deeds," declares the LORD, "and I spoke to you, rising early and speaking, yet you did not listen, and I called you, yet you did not answer,
verses.7:14: I will do to the house over which My name is called, in which you are trusting, and to the place that I gave to you and to your fathers, just as I did to Shiloh.
verses.7:15: And I will cast you away from My presence, just as I cast away all your brothers, all the seed of Ephraim."
verses.7:16: "As for you, do not pray for this people, and do not lift up a cry or a prayer on their behalf, and do not plead with Me, for I will not listen to you.
verses.7:17: Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.7:18: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead dough to make cakes for the queen of heaven, and they pour out drink offerings to other gods in order to provoke Me to anger.
verses.7:19: Is it Me whom they are provoking to anger?" declares the LORD. "Is it not themselves, to the shame of their own faces?"
verses.7:20: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: "Look, My anger and My wrath are being poured out on this place, on man and on beast, on the trees of the field and on the fruit of the ground; and it will burn and will not be extinguished."
verses.7:21: This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat meat.
verses.7:22: For I did not speak with your fathers, nor did I command them on the day I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning matters of burnt offering and sacrifice.
verses.7:23: Rather, this word I commanded them, saying, 'Listen to My voice, and I will be God to you, and you will be a people to Me; and walk in all the way that I command you, so that it may go well with you.'
verses.7:24: Yet they did not listen and did not incline their ear, but walked in counsels, in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and moved backward and not forward.
verses.7:25: From the day your fathers came out of the land of Egypt until this day, I have sent to you all My servants the prophets, daily, rising early and sending them.
verses.7:26: Yet they did not listen to Me and did not incline their ear, but stiffened their neck; they acted more wickedly than their fathers."
verses.7:27: "And you shall say to them, 'This is the nation that has not listened to the voice of the LORD its God and has not accepted discipline. Truth has perished and has been cut off from their mouth.'"
verses.7:29: "Cut off your consecrated hair and throw it away, and lift up a lament on the barren heights; for the LORD has rejected and abandoned the generation of His wrath.
verses.7:30: For the sons of Judah have done what is evil in My sight," declares the LORD. "They have set their detestable things in the house over which My name is called, to defile it.
verses.7:31: And they have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I did not command, nor did it arise in My heart.
verses.7:32: Therefore, look, days are coming," declares the LORD, "when it will no longer be called Topheth or the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, but rather the Valley of Slaughter; and they will bury in Topheth for lack of room.
verses.7:33: And the corpses of this people will become food for the birds of the sky and for the beasts of the earth, and no one will frighten them away.
verses.7:34: And I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the sound of joy and the sound of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, for the land will become a wasteland."
verses.8:1: "At that time," declares the LORD, "they will bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of its officials, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem from their graves.
verses.8:2: And they will spread them out before the sun and the moon and all the host of heaven, whom they loved, and whom they served, and after whom they walked, and whom they sought, and to whom they bowed down. They will not be gathered and will not be buried; they will become dung on the surface of the ground.
verses.8:3: And death will be chosen rather than life by all the remnant who remain of this wicked family, in all the remaining places to which I have driven them," declares the LORD of hosts.
verses.8:4: And you shall say to them, "This is what the LORD says: Do they fall and not rise up? If one turns away, does he not turn back?
verses.8:5: Why has this people, Jerusalem, turned away in an unceasing turning away? They cling to deceit; they refuse to turn back.
verses.8:6: I have paid attention and listened: they do not speak what is right. No one feels remorse over his wickedness, saying, 'What have I done?' Every one of them turns into their course, like a horse surging into the battle.
verses.8:7: Even the stork in the sky knows her appointed times, and the turtledove, the swift, and the crane keep the time of their coming; yet My people do not know the ordinance of the LORD.
verses.8:8: How can you say, 'We are wise, and the law of the LORD is with us'? Indeed, look, the false pen of the scribes has turned it into falsehood.
verses.8:9: The wise are put to shame; they are dismayed and trapped. Look, they have rejected the word of the LORD, so what kind of wisdom do they have?
verses.8:10: Therefore I will give their wives to others, their fields to those who take possession; for from the least to the greatest, every one of them is grasping for dishonest gain; from prophet to priest, every one of them practices falsehood."
verses.8:13: "I will surely sweep them away," declares the LORD. "There are no grapes on the vine, and there are no figs on the fig tree, and the leaf has withered; and what I gave them will pass away from them."
verses.8:14: "Why are we sitting still? Gather together, and let us enter the fortified cities and be silenced there; for the LORD our God has silenced us and has given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.
verses.8:15: We waited for peace, yet there is no good; for a time of healing, and look, terror!"
verses.8:16: From Dan the snorting of his horses is heard; at the sound of the neighing of his stallions the whole land quakes. They come and devour the land and its fullness, the city and those who dwell in it.
verses.8:17: "For look, I am sending among you serpents, vipers for which there is no charm, and they will bite you," declares the LORD.
verses.8:18: When I seek relief from sorrow, within me my heart is faint.
verses.8:19: Look, the sound of the cry for help of the daughter of my people from a distant land: "Is the LORD not in Zion? Is her King not in her?" "Why have they provoked Me to anger with their carved images, with foreign vanities?"
verses.8:20: "The harvest has passed, the summer is over, and we have not been saved."
verses.8:21: Because of the shattering of the daughter of my people I am shattered; I mourn; dismay has taken hold of me.
verses.8:22: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no healer there? Why then has the healing of the daughter of my people not appeared?
verses.8:23: If only my head were waters, and my eyes a spring of tears, so that I might weep day and night for those killed of the daughter of my people!
verses.9:1: If only I had in the wilderness a lodging place for travelers, so that I might abandon my people and depart from them! For all of them are adulterers, a gathering of traitors.
verses.9:2: "They bend their tongue as their bow for falsehood, and not for faithfulness have they grown mighty in the land. For they go out from evil to evil, and they do not know Me," declares the LORD.
verses.9:3: "Let each one be on guard against his neighbor, and do not trust in any brother; for every brother surely supplants, and every neighbor goes about as a slanderer.
verses.9:4: Each person deceives his neighbor, and truth they do not speak; they have taught their tongue to speak falsehood, and they wear themselves out acting perversely.
verses.9:5: You dwell amid deceit; by deceit they refuse to know Me," declares the LORD.
verses.9:6: Therefore, this is what the LORD of hosts says: "Look, I am refining them and will test them; for how else shall I act on account of the daughter of My people?
verses.9:7: Their tongue is a sharpened arrow; it speaks deceit. With his mouth a person speaks peace with his neighbor, yet within himself he sets his ambush.
verses.9:8: Shall I not punish them for these things?" declares the LORD. "On a nation like this, shall My soul not avenge itself?"
verses.9:9: "Over the mountains I will lift up weeping and wailing, and over the pastures of the wilderness a dirge, because they have been scorched so that no one passes through, and no one hears the sound of livestock. From the birds of the sky to the beasts, they have fled, they are gone.
verses.9:10: And I will turn Jerusalem into heaps of ruins, a lair of jackals, and the cities of Judah I will make a desolation, without an inhabitant."
verses.9:11: Who is the wise man who can understand this, and to whom has the mouth of the LORD spoken, that he may declare it? Why has the land perished and been scorched like the wilderness, without anyone passing through?
verses.9:12: And the LORD said, "Because they have abandoned My law which I set before them, and have not listened to My voice nor walked in it,
verses.9:13: but have walked after the stubbornness of their heart and after the Baals, which their fathers taught them."
verses.9:14: Therefore, this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "Look, I am about to feed this people wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.
verses.9:15: And I will scatter them among the nations whom neither they nor their fathers have known, and I will send the sword after them until I have consumed them."
verses.9:16: This is what the LORD of hosts says: "Consider carefully, and summon the mourning women, that they may come; send for the skilled women, that they may come!"
verses.9:17: Let them hurry and raise up wailing over us, so that our eyes may run down with tears and our eyelids flow with water.
verses.9:18: For a sound of wailing is heard from Zion: "How we are devastated! We are deeply ashamed, because we have abandoned the land, because they have cast down our dwellings."
verses.9:19: Hear now, women, the word of the LORD, and let your ear receive the word of His mouth; teach your daughters wailing, and each woman her neighbor a dirge:
verses.9:20: "For death has climbed up through our windows; it has entered our citadels, to cut off the child from the street, the young men from the public squares."
verses.9:21: Speak, "This is what the LORD declares: 'Human corpses will fall like dung upon the surface of the field, and like cut grain behind the harvester, with no one gathering them.'"
verses.9:22: This is what the LORD says: "Do not let a wise man boast in his wisdom, and do not let the mighty man boast in his might; do not let a wealthy man boast in his wealth.
verses.9:23: Rather, let the one who boasts boast in this: having insight and knowing Me, that I am the LORD who carries out loyal love, justice, and righteousness on the earth; for in these things I take delight," declares the LORD.
verses.9:24: "Look, days are coming," declares the LORD, "when I will bring punishment upon everyone circumcised yet in uncircumcision:
verses.9:25: upon Egypt, upon Judah, upon Edom, upon the sons of Ammon, upon Moab, and upon all those who clip the edges of their hair who dwell in the wilderness; for all the nations are uncircumcised, and the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart."
verses.10:1: Hear the word that the LORD has spoken to you, house of Israel.
verses.10:2: This is what the LORD says: "Do not learn the way of the nations, and do not be terrified by the signs of the heavens, even though the nations are terrified by them.
verses.10:3: For the customs of the peoples are futility; for someone cuts down a tree from the forest, the work of the hands of a craftsman with an axe.
verses.10:4: With silver and gold one adorns it; with nails and hammers they fasten them so that it does not totter.
verses.10:5: They are like a scarecrow in a cucumber patch, and they cannot speak; they must indeed be carried, because they cannot take a step. Do not be afraid of them, for they cannot cause harm, nor is doing good within their power.
verses.10:9: Beaten silver is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of a craftsman and the hands of a goldsmith; blue and purple are their clothing; all of them are the work of skilled artisans.
verses.10:11: In this way you shall say to them: 'The gods who did not make the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth and from beneath these heavens.'"
verses.10:12: He is the One who made the earth by His strength, who firmly established the world by His wisdom, and by His understanding He stretched out the heavens.
verses.10:13: When He utters His voice, there is a tumult of waters in the heavens, and He makes clouds ascend from the ends of the earth; He makes flashes of lightning for the rain, and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
verses.10:14: Every human being is senseless, without knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by a carved image, for his cast metal image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
verses.10:15: They are futility, a work of mockery; at the time of their punishment they will perish.
verses.10:16: Not like these is the portion of Jacob, for He is the Fashioner of everything, and Israel is the tribe of His inheritance; the LORD of hosts is His name.
verses.10:17: Gather up your bundle from the ground, you who dwell under siege.
verses.10:18: For this is what the LORD says: "Look, I am slinging out the inhabitants of the land at this time, and I will bring distress upon them so that they may feel it."
verses.10:19: Woe to me because of my shattering! My wound is grievous. Yet I said, "Surely this is a sickness, and I must bear it."
verses.10:20: My tent is devastated, and all my cords are snapped. My children have gone out from me and are no more; there is no one anymore to stretch out my tent and set up my curtains.
verses.10:21: For the shepherds have become senseless and have not sought the LORD; therefore they have not prospered, and their entire flock is scattered.
verses.10:22: The sound of a report! Look, it comes, and a great commotion from the land of the north, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a lair of jackals.
verses.10:23: I know, LORD, that a human being's way is not his own; it does not belong to the person who walks to direct his step.
verses.10:24: Discipline me, LORD, yet in justice; not in Your anger, or else You will reduce me to nothing.
verses.10:25: Pour out Your wrath upon the nations that do not know You, and upon the families that do not call on Your name; for they have devoured Jacob; they have devoured him and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.
verses.11:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying:
verses.11:2: "Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.11:3: And you shall say to them, 'This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Cursed is the man who does not listen to the words of this covenant,
verses.11:4: which I commanded your fathers on the day I brought them out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying: Listen to My voice, and do them according to all that I command you; then you will be My people, and I will be your God,
verses.11:5: in order to uphold the oath that I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as at this day.'" And I answered and said, "Amen, LORD."
verses.11:6: And the LORD said to me, "Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, 'Hear the words of this covenant and do them.'
verses.11:8: Yet they did not listen and did not incline their ear, but walked, each one in the stubbornness of their evil heart. Therefore I brought upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do, yet they did not."
verses.11:9: Then the LORD said to me, "A conspiracy has been found among the men of Judah and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.11:10: They have turned back to the iniquities of their earlier forefathers, who refused to listen to My words; and they themselves have gone after other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken My covenant which I made with their fathers."
verses.11:11: Therefore, this is what the LORD says: "Look, I am bringing disaster upon them from which they will not be able to escape. And they will cry out to Me, yet I will not listen to them.
verses.11:12: Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to whom they burn incense, but they will not save them at all in the time of their disaster.
verses.11:13: For your gods have become as numerous as your cities, Judah; and as many as the streets of Jerusalem, you have set up altars to that shameful thing, altars to burn incense to Baal.
verses.11:14: As for you, do not pray for this people, and do not lift up a cry or a prayer on their behalf; for I will not listen at the time when they call to Me because of their disaster.
verses.11:15: What right has My beloved in My house, since she has carried out vile schemes with many, and consecrated flesh passes away from you? When you do your evil, then you exult!
verses.11:16: 'A flourishing olive tree, beautiful in fruit and form,' the LORD called your name; with the roar of a great tumult He has kindled fire upon it, and its branches are broken.
verses.11:17: And the LORD of hosts, who planted you, has pronounced disaster against you because of the evil of the house of Israel and the house of Judah, which they have done for themselves to provoke Me to anger by burning incense to Baal."
verses.11:18: Now the LORD made it known to me, and I knew; then You showed me their deeds.
verses.11:19: Yet I was like a tame lamb brought to the slaughter, and I did not know that they had plotted schemes against me: "Let us destroy the tree with its fruit, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, so that his name will be remembered no longer."
verses.11:20: Yet, LORD of hosts, who judges righteously, who tests the kidneys and the heart, let me see Your vengeance upon them, for to You I have revealed my cause.
verses.11:21: Therefore, this is what the LORD says concerning the men of Anathoth, who seek your life, saying, "Do not prophesy in the name of the LORD, so that you will not die by our hand."
verses.11:22: Therefore, this is what the LORD of hosts says: "Look, I am about to punish them: the young men will die by the sword; their sons and their daughters will die by famine.
verses.11:23: And there will be no remnant for them, for I will bring disaster upon the men of Anathoth in the year of their punishment."
verses.12:1: Righteous are You, LORD, even if I contend with You; yet I will speak with You regarding judgments. Why does the way of the wicked succeed? Why are all who act in treachery untroubled?
verses.12:2: You have planted them, and they have taken root; they keep growing, and they even yield fruit. You are near in their mouth, yet far from their innermost being.
verses.12:3: Yet You, LORD, know me; You see me, and You have examined my heart toward You. Drag them off like sheep for slaughter, and set them apart for a day of killing.
verses.12:4: How long will the land mourn and the vegetation of every field wither? Because of the wickedness of those who dwell in it, animals and birds have been swept away; for they have said, "He will not see our end."
verses.12:5: If you have raced with men on foot and they have exhausted you, then how will you compete with horses? And though you feel safe in a land of peace, how will you fare in the thicket of the Jordan?
verses.12:6: For even your brothers and your father's house, even they have acted treacherously against you; even they have cried out in full voice after you. Do not trust them, even when they speak pleasant words to you.
verses.12:7: I have forsaken My house; I have abandoned My inheritance. I have given the beloved of My soul into the grasp of her enemies.
verses.12:8: My inheritance has become to Me like a lion in the forest; she has lifted her voice against Me, therefore I hate her.
verses.12:9: Is My inheritance a speckled bird of prey to Me? Are the birds of prey all around against her? Go, gather all the wild beasts of the field; bring them to devour!
verses.12:10: Many shepherds have ruined My vineyard; they have trampled down My plot of land. They have turned My cherished plot into a wilderness of desolation.
verses.12:11: They have made it a desolation; desolate, it mourns to Me. The entire land has been laid desolate, because no man lays it to heart.
verses.12:12: Over all the bare heights in the wilderness devastators have come, for a sword of the LORD devours from one end of the land to the other end of the land; there is no peace for any flesh.
verses.12:13: They have sown wheat, yet thorns they have reaped; they have exhausted themselves without profit. Be ashamed over your yields because of the burning anger of the LORD.
verses.12:14: This is what the LORD says: "Concerning all My evil neighbors who touch the inheritance that I caused My people Israel to inherit, look, I am about to uproot them from their soil, and I will uproot the house of Judah from their midst.
verses.12:15: And it will happen that after I have uprooted them, I will once again have compassion on them, and I will bring them back, each one to his inheritance and each one to his land.
verses.12:16: And it will be that if they truly learn the ways of My people, to swear by My name, 'As the LORD lives,' just as they taught My people to swear by Baal, then they will be built up in the midst of My people.
verses.12:17: But if they will not listen, then I will uproot that nation, uprooting and destroying it," declares the LORD.
verses.13:1: This is what the LORD said to me: "Go and buy yourself a linen waistcloth and put it around your waist, but do not put it into water."
verses.13:2: So I bought the waistcloth according to the word of the LORD, and I put it around my waist.
verses.13:3: Then the word of the LORD came to me a second time, saying,
verses.13:4: "Take the waistcloth that you bought, which is around your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a crevice of the rock."
verses.13:5: So I went and hid it by the Euphrates, just as the LORD had commanded me.
verses.13:6: And at the end of many days, the LORD said to me, "Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take from there the waistcloth that I commanded you to hide there."
verses.13:7: So I went to the Euphrates and dug, and took the waistcloth from the place where I had hidden it; and look, the waistcloth was ruined; it was fit for nothing.
verses.13:8: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying:
verses.13:9: "This is what the LORD says: In this very way I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.
verses.13:10: This evil people, who refuse to listen to My words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart, and have gone after other gods to serve them and to bow down to them, shall become just like this waistcloth, which is fit for nothing.
verses.13:11: For just as the waistcloth clings to a man's waist, so I caused the entire house of Israel and the entire house of Judah to cling to Me, declares the LORD, to be for Me a people, a name, a praise, and a splendor; yet they did not listen.
verses.13:12: And you shall speak this word to them: 'This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Every jar will be filled with wine.' And they will say to you, 'Do we not surely know that every jar will be filled with wine?'
verses.13:13: Then you shall say to them, 'This is what the LORD says: Look, I am about to fill all the inhabitants of this land—even the kings who sit for David on his throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem—with drunkenness.
verses.13:14: And I will smash them one against another, both the fathers and the sons together, declares the LORD. I will not pity, nor spare, nor show compassion so as to keep from ruining them.'"
verses.13:15: Listen and give ear; do not be arrogant, for the LORD has spoken.
verses.13:16: Give glory to the LORD your God before He brings darkness, and before your feet stumble on the twilight mountains; while you wait for light, He turns it into deep shadow and makes it into thick gloom.
verses.13:17: But if you do not listen to it, my soul will weep in secret places because of pride; my eye will weep bitterly and stream with tears, because the flock of the LORD has been taken captive.
verses.13:18: Say to the king and to the queen mother, "Take a lowly seat, for your crown of splendor has come down from your heads."
verses.13:19: The cities of the Negev are shut up, with no one to open them; all of Judah has been carried into exile, carried wholly into exile.
verses.13:20: Lift up your eyes and see those who are coming from the north. Where is the flock that was given to you, the sheep of your splendor?
verses.13:21: What will you say when He appoints over you—since you yourself have trained them over you—close allies as head? Will not pangs seize you like a woman in labor?
verses.13:22: And if you say in your heart, "Why have these things happened to me?" It is because of the abundance of your iniquity that your skirts have been uncovered and your heels have suffered violence.
verses.13:23: Can a Cushite change his skin, or a leopard his spots? Then you as well could do good, you who are trained to do evil.
verses.13:24: So I will scatter them like drifting chaff before a wilderness wind.
verses.13:25: This is your lot, the portion measured out for you from Me, declares the LORD, because you have forgotten Me and have trusted in falsehood.
verses.13:26: So I Myself will strip back your skirts over your face, and your disgrace will be seen.
verses.13:27: Your adulteries and your neighings, the lewdness of your prostitution—on the hills in the field I have seen your detestable acts! Woe to you, Jerusalem! You will not become clean; how much longer still?
verses.14:1: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the droughts.
verses.14:2: Judah mourns, and her gates languish; they sink to the ground in gloom, and the outcry of Jerusalem rises up.
verses.14:3: Their nobles send their attendants for water; they come to the cisterns and find no water. They return with their vessels empty; they are ashamed and humiliated, and they cover their heads.
verses.14:4: Because the ground is cracked, for there has been no rain in the land, the farmers are ashamed; they cover their heads.
verses.14:5: For even the doe in the field gives birth and forsakes her young, because there is no fresh grass.
verses.14:6: The wild donkeys stand on the bare heights; they pant for air like jackals. Their eyes fail, because there is no vegetation.
verses.14:7: Though our iniquities testify against us, LORD, act for the sake of Your name! Indeed, our apostasies are many; against You we have sinned.
verses.14:8: Hope of Israel, its Savior in time of distress, why should You be like a sojourner in the land, and like a traveler who turns aside to lodge for the night?
verses.14:9: Why should You be like a stunned man, like a mighty warrior who cannot save? Yet You are in our midst, LORD, and Your name is called over us; do not leave us!
verses.14:10: This is what the LORD says concerning this people: "This is how they have loved to wander; they have not held back their feet. And the LORD does not accept them; now He will remember their iniquity and call their sins to account."
verses.14:11: Then the LORD said to me, "Do not pray on behalf of this people for their good.
verses.14:12: When they fast, I will not listen to their outcry; and when they offer up burnt offering and grain offering, I will not accept them. Rather, by sword, famine, and pestilence I am going to consume them."
verses.14:13: Then I said, "Ah, Lord GOD! Look, the prophets are saying to them, 'You will not see the sword, nor will you have famine; rather, I will give you true peace in this place.'"
verses.14:14: And the LORD said to me, "The prophets are prophesying falsehood in My name. I did not send them, nor did I command them, nor did I speak to them. They are prophesying to you a vision of falsehood, divination, futility, and the deceit of their own heart.
verses.14:15: Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning the prophets who prophesy in My name, though I did not send them, yet they say, 'Sword and famine will not be in this land': By the sword and by famine those very prophets will perish.
verses.14:16: And the people to whom they are prophesying will be flung out into the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword, with no one to bury them—them, their wives, their sons, and their daughters. Thus I will pour out their own evil upon them.
verses.14:17: And you shall speak this word to them: 'Let my eyes stream with tears night and day, and let them not cease; for the virgin daughter of my people has been shattered with a great shattering, with a most grievous wound.
verses.14:18: If I go out into the field, look, those pierced by the sword! And if I enter the city, look, the sicknesses of famine! For both prophet and priest go wandering through the land, and they do not understand.'"
verses.14:19: Have You altogether rejected Judah? Does Your soul abhor Zion? Why have You struck us, with no healing for us? We hoped for peace, yet there is no good; and for a time of healing, yet look, terror!
verses.14:20: We acknowledge our wickedness, LORD, and the iniquity of our fathers, for we have sinned against You.
verses.14:21: Do not spurn us, for the sake of Your name; do not dishonor the throne of Your glory. Remember; do not break Your covenant with us.
verses.14:22: Are there any among the worthless idols of the nations who can bring rain? Or can the heavens give showers? Are You not the One, LORD our God? Therefore we hope in You, for it is You who have made all these things.
verses.15:1: Then the LORD said to me, "Even if Moses and Samuel stood before Me, My soul would not be toward this people. Send them away from before My face, and let them go out.
verses.15:2: And it will be, when they say to you, 'Where shall we go out?' you shall say to them, 'This is what the LORD says: Whoever is for death, to death; and whoever is for the sword, to the sword; and whoever is for famine, to famine; and whoever is for captivity, to captivity.'
verses.15:3: I will appoint over them four kinds, declares the LORD: the sword to kill, and the dogs to drag away, and the birds of the sky and the beasts of the earth to devour and to destroy.
verses.15:4: And I will make them an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth on account of Manasseh son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for what he did in Jerusalem.
verses.15:5: For who will have pity on you, Jerusalem, and who will grieve for you, and who will turn aside to ask about your welfare?
verses.15:6: You have abandoned Me, declares the LORD; you keep going backward. So I have stretched out My hand against you and destroyed you; I am weary of relenting.
verses.15:7: I winnowed them with a winnowing fork in the gates of the land; I have bereaved, I have destroyed My people; they did not turn back from their ways.
verses.15:8: Their widows have become more numerous to Me than the sand of the seas; I have brought upon them, against the mother of young men, a destroyer at noon; I have caused anguish and terrors to fall suddenly upon her.
verses.15:9: She who bore seven has languished; she has gasped out her life. Her sun has gone down while it is still day; she is shamed and disgraced. And their remnant I will give to the sword before their enemies, declares the LORD."
verses.15:10: Woe to me, my mother, that you bore me as a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole land! I have not lent, nor have they lent to me, yet every one of them curses me.
verses.15:11: The LORD said, "Surely I will set you free for good; surely I will cause the enemy to plead with you in a time of calamity and in a time of distress.
verses.15:12: Can iron shatter iron from the north and bronze?
verses.15:13: Your wealth and your treasures I will give for plunder, without a price, because of all your sins and throughout all your borders.
verses.15:14: And I will make you pass over with your enemies into a land you have not known, for a fire has kindled in My anger; against you it will burn."
verses.15:15: You know, LORD; remember me and attend to me, and avenge me on my pursuers. In Your slowness to anger do not take me away; know that for Your sake I bear reproach.
verses.15:16: Your words were found, and I ate them; and Your word became to me exultation and the gladness of my heart, for Your name is called over me, LORD, God of hosts.
verses.15:17: I did not sit in the company of revelers and rejoice; because of Your hand I sat alone, for You have filled me with indignation.
verses.15:18: Why has my pain become unending and my wound incurable, refusing to be healed? Will You truly be to me like a failing stream, waters that are not dependable?
verses.15:19: Therefore, this is what the LORD says: "If you turn back, then I will restore you; before Me you shall stand. And if you bring forth what is precious from what is worthless, you shall be as My mouth. They shall turn to you, but you shall not turn to them.
verses.15:20: And I will make you to this people a fortified wall of bronze; they will fight against you, but they will not prevail over you, for I am with you to save you and to deliver you, declares the LORD.
verses.15:21: I will deliver you from the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you from the grasp of the ruthless."
verses.16:1: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.16:2: "You shall not take a wife for yourself, nor shall you have sons or daughters in this place.
verses.16:3: For this is what the LORD says concerning the sons and the daughters born in this place, and concerning their mothers who bear them, and concerning their fathers who father them in this land:
verses.16:4: They will die of fatal diseases; they will not be lamented, nor will they be buried; they will become dung on the surface of the ground. By the sword and by famine they will come to an end, and their corpses will become food for the birds of the sky and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.16:5: For this is what the LORD says: Do not enter a house of mourning, do not go to lament, and do not grieve for them; for I have withdrawn My peace from this people, declares the LORD—loyal love and compassion.
verses.16:6: Both great and small will die in this land; they will not be buried, nor will anyone lament for them, nor will anyone cut himself or shave his head bald for them.
verses.16:7: No one will break bread for them in mourning to comfort one over the dead, nor give them the cup of consolation to drink for his father or for his mother.
verses.16:8: And you shall not enter a house of feasting to sit with them to eat and to drink.
verses.16:9: For this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Look, I am about to cause the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, to cease from this place, before your eyes and in your days.
verses.16:10: And it will be, when you declare to this people all these words, and they say to you, 'Why has the LORD pronounced all this great calamity against us? And what is our iniquity, and what is our sin that we have sinned against the LORD our God?'
verses.16:11: then you shall say to them, 'Because your fathers abandoned Me, declares the LORD, and went after other gods and served them and bowed down to them, while Me they abandoned and My law they did not keep.
verses.16:12: And you have done more evil than your fathers; and look, each of you walks after the stubbornness of his evil heart, so as not to listen to Me.
verses.16:13: Therefore I will hurl you from this land into a land that neither you nor your fathers have known, and there you shall serve other gods day and night, for I will grant you no favor.'
verses.16:14: Therefore, look, days are coming, declares the LORD, when it will no longer be said, 'As the LORD lives, who brought up the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt,'
verses.16:15: but rather, 'As the LORD lives, who brought up the sons of Israel from the land of the north and from all the lands to which He had banished them.' And I will bring them back to their own soil that I gave to their fathers.
verses.16:16: Look, I am sending for many fishermen, declares the LORD, and they will fish them out; and afterward I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them from every mountain and from every hill and out of the clefts of the rocks.
verses.16:17: For My eyes are upon all their ways; they are not hidden from before Me, nor is their iniquity concealed from before My eyes.
verses.16:18: First, I will repay double for their iniquity and their sin, because they have profaned My land; with the carcasses of their detestable things and their abominations they have filled My inheritance."
verses.16:19: LORD, my strength and my stronghold, and my refuge in the day of distress, to You nations will come from the ends of the earth and say, "Our fathers have inherited nothing but falsehood, futility, and things in which there is no profit."
verses.16:20: Can man make gods for himself, when they are not gods?
verses.16:21: "Therefore, look, I am about to make them know; this once I will make them know My hand and My might, and they will know that My name is the LORD."
verses.17:5: This is what the LORD says: "Cursed is the man who trusts in humanity and makes flesh his arm, while his heart turns aside from the LORD.
verses.17:6: He will be like a shrub in the desert plain and will not see when good comes; he will dwell in parched places in the wilderness, a salt land that is not inhabited.
verses.17:7: Blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, and the LORD is his confidence.
verses.17:8: He will be like a tree planted beside water, sending out its roots toward a stream; it does not see when heat comes, and its foliage stays green; in a year of drought it is not anxious, and it does not stop yielding fruit.
verses.17:9: The heart is more deceitful than anything else, and it is incurably sick; who can know it?
verses.17:10: I, the LORD, search the heart and test the inward parts, to give to each man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his deeds.
verses.17:11: Like a partridge brooding over what it did not lay is one who acquires wealth, yet not by justice; in the middle of his days it will forsake him, and at his end he will be a fool."
verses.17:12: A throne of glory, exalted from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.
verses.17:13: LORD, the hope of Israel, all who forsake You will be put to shame; and those who turn aside from Me will be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the spring of living water, the LORD.
verses.17:14: Heal me, LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved, for You are my praise.
verses.17:15: Look, they keep saying to me, "Where is the word of the LORD? Let it come now!"
verses.17:16: Yet I have not hurried away from being a shepherd following You, nor have I longed for the woeful day; You Yourself know. What came out of my lips was right before Your face.
verses.17:17: Do not become a terror to me; You are my refuge in the day of calamity.
verses.17:18: Let my pursuers be put to shame, but let me not be put to shame; let them be terrified, but let me not be terrified. Bring upon them a day of calamity, and shatter them with double destruction.
verses.17:19: This is what the LORD said to me: "Go and stand in the Gate of the Sons of the People, through which the kings of Judah enter and through which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem,
verses.17:20: and say to them, 'Hear the word of the LORD, kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all inhabitants of Jerusalem who enter through these gates:
verses.17:21: This is what the LORD says: Take care for your lives, and do not carry a burden on the Sabbath day or bring it in through the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.17:22: Do not carry a burden out of your houses on the Sabbath day, nor do any work, but keep the Sabbath day holy, just as I commanded your fathers.
verses.17:23: Yet they did not listen and did not incline their ear, but stiffened their neck so as not to listen and not to receive discipline.
verses.17:24: And it will be, if you diligently listen to Me, declares the LORD, by bringing no burden through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, and by keeping the Sabbath day holy so as not to do any work on it,
verses.17:25: then kings and princes who sit on the throne of David will enter through the gates of this city, riding in chariots and on horses, they and their princes, the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and this city will be inhabited forever.
verses.17:26: And people will come from the cities of Judah, from the places around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin, from the lowland, from the hill country, and from the Negev, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices, grain offerings and frankincense, and bringing thank offerings to the house of the LORD.
verses.17:27: But if you do not listen to Me, to keep the Sabbath day holy and not to carry a burden and enter through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle a fire in its gates, and it will devour the citadels of Jerusalem and will not be quenched.'"
verses.18:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.18:2: "Get up and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause you to hear My words."
verses.18:3: So I went down to the potter's house, and look, he was doing work on the wheel.
verses.18:4: And the vessel that he was making of clay was ruined in the potter's hand; so he made it again into another vessel, just as it was right in the potter's eyes to do.
verses.18:5: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.18:6: "Am I not able to do with you like this potter, house of Israel?" declares the LORD. "Look, like the clay in the potter's hand, so are you in My hand, house of Israel.
verses.18:7: At one moment I may speak concerning a nation and concerning a kingdom, to uproot and to tear down and to destroy;
verses.18:8: if that nation against which I have spoken turns from its evil, then I will relent concerning the calamity that I planned to do to it.
verses.18:9: And at another moment I may speak concerning a nation and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant;
verses.18:10: if it does what is evil in My eyes, by not listening to My voice, then I will relent concerning the good that I said I would do to benefit it.
verses.18:11: And now, speak to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, 'This is what the LORD says: Look, I am forming calamity against you and devising a plan against you. Turn back now, each man from his evil way, and make your ways and your deeds good.'
verses.18:12: But they will say, 'It is hopeless! For we will walk after our own plans, and each of us will carry out the stubbornness of his evil heart.'"
verses.18:13: Therefore this is what the LORD says: "Ask now among the nations: Who has heard things like these? The virgin Israel has done a most horrifying thing.
verses.18:14: Does the snow of Lebanon depart from the rock of the open country? Or do the cold, flowing waters from afar fail?
verses.18:15: Yet My people have forgotten Me; they burn incense to what is worthless, and they have caused them to stumble in their ways, the ancient paths, to walk in trails, on a road not built up,
verses.18:16: to make their land a desolation, an object of perpetual hissing; everyone who passes by it will be appalled and will shake his head.
verses.18:17: Like an east wind I will scatter them before an enemy; I will see their back and not their face in the day of their disaster."
verses.18:18: Then they said, "Come, let us devise plans against Jeremiah, for instruction will not perish from a priest, nor counsel from a wise man, nor a word from a prophet. Come, let us strike him with the tongue, and let us not pay attention to any of his words."
verses.18:19: Pay attention to me, LORD, and listen to the voice of my adversaries.
verses.18:20: Should evil be repaid for good? Yet they have dug a pit for my life. Remember how I stood before You to speak good on their behalf, to turn Your wrath away from them.
verses.18:21: Therefore give their children over to famine, and pour them out to the power of the sword; let their wives become childless and widowed. Let their men be killed by death, and their young men struck down by the sword in battle.
verses.18:22: Let an outcry be heard from their houses when You bring a raiding band upon them suddenly! For they have dug a pit to capture me and have hidden snares for my feet.
verses.18:23: Yet You, LORD, know all their counsel against me to put me to death. Do not forgive their iniquity, and do not blot out their sin from before You. Let them be made to stumble before You; deal with them in the time of Your anger.
verses.19:1: This is what the LORD says: "Go and buy a potter's earthenware flask, and take some of the elders of the people and some of the elders of the priests,
verses.19:2: and go out to the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, which is at the entrance of the Potsherd Gate, and proclaim there the words that I speak to you.
verses.19:3: You shall say, 'Hear the word of the LORD, kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem. This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Look, I am bringing calamity upon this place, such that the ears of everyone who hears of it will tingle,
verses.19:4: because they have forsaken Me and have alienated this place, and have burned incense in it to other gods whom neither they nor their fathers nor the kings of Judah have known, and because they have filled this place with the blood of the innocent,
verses.19:5: and have built the high places of Baal to burn their sons in the fire as burnt offerings to Baal, something I did not command or speak of, nor did it come into My heart.
verses.19:6: Therefore, look, days are coming, declares the LORD, when this place will no longer be called Topheth or the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, but rather the Valley of Slaughter.
verses.19:7: And I will empty out the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place, and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies and by the hand of those who seek their life. And I will give their corpses as food for the birds of the sky and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.19:8: And I will make this city a desolation and an object of hissing; everyone who passes by it will be appalled and will hiss because of all its wounds.
verses.19:9: And I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and each one will eat the flesh of his neighbor in the siege and in the distress with which their enemies and those who seek their life will distress them.'
verses.19:10: Then you shall shatter the flask before the eyes of the men who go with you,
verses.19:11: and you shall say to them, 'This is what the LORD of hosts says: In this way I will shatter this people and this city, just as one shatters a potter's vessel that cannot be mended again. And they will bury in Topheth for lack of a place to bury.
verses.19:12: Thus I will do to this place, declares the LORD, and to its inhabitants, even making this city like Topheth.
verses.19:13: And the houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah will become defiled like the place of Topheth, all the houses on whose rooftops they burned incense to all the host of heaven and poured out drink offerings to other gods.'"
verses.19:14: Then Jeremiah came from Topheth, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of the house of the LORD and said to all the people,
verses.19:15: "This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Look, I am bringing upon this city and upon all its towns all the calamity that I have spoken against it, because they have stiffened their necks so as not to listen to My words."
verses.20:1: Now Pashhur the son of Immer, the priest, who was chief officer in the house of the LORD, heard Jeremiah prophesying these words.
verses.20:2: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were at the Upper Gate of Benjamin, which was in the house of the LORD.
verses.20:3: On the next day, when Pashhur brought Jeremiah out of the stocks, Jeremiah said to him, "The LORD has not called your name Pashhur, but rather Terror All Around.
verses.20:4: For this is what the LORD says: 'Look, I am making you a terror to yourself and to all your friends, and they will fall by the sword of their enemies while your eyes look on. And I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will carry them into exile to Babylon and strike them down with the sword.
verses.20:5: And I will give all the wealth of this city, and all the produce of its labor, and all its precious things; and all the treasures of the kings of Judah I will give into the hand of their enemies, and they will plunder them and take them and bring them to Babylon.
