verses.20:6: And you, Pashhur, and all who live in your house will go into captivity; you will go to Babylon, and there you will die and there you will be buried, you and all your friends to whom you have prophesied falsely.'"
verses.20:7: You enticed me, LORD, and I was enticed; You overpowered me and prevailed. I have become a laughingstock all day long; everyone mocks me.
verses.20:8: For whenever I speak, I cry out; I shout, "Violence and devastation!" For the word of the LORD has become scorn and ridicule to me all day long.
verses.20:9: If I say, "I will not remember Him and I will not speak anymore in His name," then in my heart it becomes like a burning fire, shut up in my bones; I grow weary of holding it in, and I cannot.
verses.20:10: For I have heard the whispering of many: "Terror all around! Denounce him! Let us denounce him!" All my close friends are watching for my stumbling: "Perhaps he will be enticed, and we can prevail against him and take our vengeance on him."
verses.20:11: But the LORD is with me like a fearsome warrior; therefore my persecutors will stumble and will not prevail. They will be utterly put to shame, for they have not succeeded; everlasting dishonor will not be forgotten.
verses.20:12: Yet, LORD of hosts, You who test the righteous, who see the inmost being and the heart, let me see Your vengeance on them, for to You I have laid open my case.
verses.20:13: Sing to the LORD! Praise the LORD! For He has delivered the life of the needy from the hand of evildoers.
verses.20:14: Cursed be the day on which I was born! Let the day when my mother gave birth to me not be blessed!
verses.20:15: Cursed be the man who brought the news to my father, saying, "A male child has been born to you!" making him very glad.
verses.20:16: Let that man be like the cities that the LORD overthrew and did not relent; let him hear an outcry in the morning and a battle shout at noontime,
verses.20:17: because he did not put me to death in the womb, so that my mother would have been my grave, and her womb pregnant forever.
verses.20:18: Why is it that I came out from the womb to see trouble and sorrow, and for my days to end in shame?
verses.21:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD when King Zedekiah sent Pashhur son of Malchijah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, the priest, to him, saying,
verses.21:2: "Please inquire of the LORD on our behalf, for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is fighting against us. Perhaps the LORD will deal with us according to all His wondrous deeds, so that he will withdraw from us."
verses.21:3: Then Jeremiah said to them, "This is what you shall say to Zedekiah:
verses.21:4: 'This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Look, I am turning back the weapons of war that are in your hands, with which you are fighting against the king of Babylon and the Chaldeans who are laying siege against you outside the wall, and I will gather them into the middle of this city.
verses.21:5: And I Myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, and in anger, in fury, and in great indignation.
verses.21:6: And I will strike the inhabitants of this city, both human and animal; they will die by a great pestilence.
verses.21:7: And afterward, declares the LORD, I will give Zedekiah king of Judah, his servants, the people, and those remaining in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their lives. He will strike them down with the edge of the sword; he will not spare them, nor show pity, nor have compassion.'"
verses.21:8: And to this people you shall say, "This is what the LORD says: Look, I am placing before you the way of life and the way of death.
verses.21:9: Whoever remains in this city will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence; but whoever goes out and surrenders to the Chaldeans who are laying siege against you will live, and his life will be his as plunder.
verses.21:10: For I have set My face against this city for harm and not for good, declares the LORD. It will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire."
verses.21:11: And to the house of the king of Judah: Hear the word of the LORD!
verses.21:12: House of David, this is what the LORD says: "Execute justice in the morning, and rescue the one who has been robbed from the hand of the oppressor, or else My fury will go out like fire and burn with no one to extinguish it, because of the evil of your deeds.
verses.21:13: Look, I am against you, dweller of the valley, rock of the plain, declares the LORD—you who say, 'Who will come down against us, and who will enter our dwellings?'
verses.21:14: And I will punish you according to the fruit of your deeds, declares the LORD; and I will ignite a fire in her forest, and it will consume all her surroundings."
verses.22:1: This is what the LORD says: "Go down to the house of the king of Judah and speak this word there,
verses.22:2: and say, 'Hear the word of the LORD, king of Judah who sits on the throne of David—you, your servants, and your people who enter by these gates.
verses.22:3: This is what the LORD says: Practice justice and righteousness, and rescue the one who has been robbed from the hand of the oppressor. Do not wrong or deal violently with the sojourner, the orphan, and the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place.
verses.22:4: For if you indeed do this thing, then kings who sit for David on his throne will enter through the gates of this house, riding in chariots and on horses—he, his servants, and his people.
verses.22:5: But if you do not heed these words, I swear by Myself, declares the LORD, that this house will become a ruin.'"
verses.22:6: For this is what the LORD says concerning the house of the king of Judah: "You are Gilead to Me, the summit of Lebanon; yet I will surely make you a wilderness, cities not inhabited.
verses.22:7: And I will consecrate destroyers against you, each with his weapons; and they will cut down your finest cedars and cast them onto the fire.
verses.22:8: And many nations will pass by this city, and each one will say to his neighbor, 'Why has the LORD done so to this great city?'
verses.22:9: And they will say, 'Because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD their God and bowed down to other gods and served them.'"
verses.22:10: Do not weep for the dead, and do not grieve for him; weep deeply for the one who is going away, for he will not return again and see the land of his birth.
verses.22:11: For this is what the LORD says concerning Shallum son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned in place of Josiah his father, who has gone out from this place: "He will not return there again;
verses.22:12: but in the place where they exiled him, there he will die, and this land he will not see again."
verses.22:13: "Woe to the one who builds his house without righteousness and his upper chambers without justice, who makes his neighbor work for nothing and does not give him his wages,
verses.22:14: who says, 'I will build for myself a large house and airy upper chambers,' and cuts open windows for himself, paneled with cedar and coated with vermilion.
verses.22:15: Do you reign because you vie in cedar? Your father—did he not eat and drink, and practice justice and righteousness? Then it went well with him.
verses.22:16: He judged the case of the afflicted and needy; then it went well. Is that not knowing Me? declares the LORD.
verses.22:17: Yet your eyes and your heart are on nothing but your unjust gain, and on shedding the blood of the innocent, and on practicing oppression and violence."
verses.22:18: Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah: "They will not lament for him, 'Alas, my brother!' or 'Alas, sister!' They will not lament for him, 'Alas, lord!' or 'Alas, his majesty!'
verses.22:19: With the burial of a donkey he will be buried—dragged away and thrown beyond the gates of Jerusalem."
verses.22:20: "Go up to Lebanon and cry out, and in Bashan lift up your voice, and cry out from Abarim, for all your lovers have been shattered.
verses.22:21: I spoke to you in your security; you said, 'I will not listen.' This has been your way since your youth, for you have not listened to My voice.
verses.22:22: The wind will shepherd all your shepherds, and your lovers will go into captivity; for then you will be ashamed and disgraced because of all your wickedness.
verses.22:23: You who inhabit Lebanon, who are nested in the cedars, how pitiable you will be when labor pains come upon you, anguish like a woman giving birth!"
verses.22:24: "As I live, declares the LORD, even if Coniah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, were a signet ring on My right hand, yet from there I would tear you off.
verses.22:25: And I will give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand of those whom you dread, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.22:26: And I will hurl you and your mother who gave birth to you into another land where you were not born, and there you will die.
verses.22:27: But to the land to which they lift up their soul to return, there they will not return."
verses.22:28: Is this man Coniah a despised, shattered pot, or a vessel in which there is no delight? Why have he and his seed been hurled away and thrown into a land that they did not know?
verses.22:29: Land, land, land, hear the word of the LORD!
verses.22:30: This is what the LORD says: "Register this man as childless, a man who will not succeed in his days; for no man from his seed will succeed, sitting on the throne of David and ruling again in Judah."
verses.23:1: "Woe to shepherds who destroy and scatter the flock of My pasture!" declares the LORD.
verses.23:2: Therefore this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says against the shepherds who shepherd My people: "You yourselves have scattered My flock and driven them away, and have not cared for them. Look, I am about to hold you accountable for the evil of your deeds," declares the LORD.
verses.23:3: "And I Myself will gather the remnant of My flock out of all the lands where I have driven them, and I will bring them back to their pastureland, and they will be fruitful and multiply.
verses.23:4: I will also raise up shepherds over them who will tend them; and they will no longer be afraid, nor be terrified, nor will any be missing," declares the LORD.
verses.23:5: "Look, days are coming," declares the LORD, "when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch; a king will reign and act with insight, and he will carry out justice and righteousness in the land.
verses.23:6: In his days Judah will be delivered, and Israel will dwell in safety; and this is his name by which he will be called: 'The LORD Is Our Righteousness.'"
verses.23:7: "Therefore look, days are coming," declares the LORD, "when they will no longer say, 'As the LORD lives, who brought the sons of Israel up out of the land of Egypt,'
verses.23:8: but rather, 'As the LORD lives, who brought up and who brought the seed of the house of Israel out of the northern land and out of all the lands where I had driven them.' Then they will dwell on their own soil."
verses.23:9: Concerning the prophets: My heart is broken within me; all my bones tremble. I have become like a drunk man, and like a man whom wine has overwhelmed, because of the LORD and because of His holy words.
verses.23:10: For the land is filled with adulterers; because of a curse the land mourns, and the pastures of the wilderness have dried up. Their course is evil, and their might is not right.
verses.23:11: "For both prophet and priest are godless; even in My own house I have found their evil," declares the LORD.
verses.23:12: "Therefore their way will be for them like slippery ground in deep darkness; they will be driven along and fall in it. For I will bring disaster upon them in the year of their reckoning," declares the LORD.
verses.23:13: "Among the prophets of Samaria I saw something unseemly: they prophesied by Baal and led My people Israel astray.
verses.23:14: But among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen an appalling thing: committing adultery and walking in falsehood; and they strengthen the hands of evildoers so that no one turns back from his evil. All of them have become like Sodom to Me, and her inhabitants like Gomorrah."
verses.23:15: Therefore this is what the LORD of hosts says concerning the prophets: "Look, I am about to feed them wormwood and make them drink poisoned water; for from the prophets of Jerusalem godlessness has gone out into the whole land."
verses.23:16: This is what the LORD of hosts says: "Do not listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you; they are filling you with emptiness. They speak a vision of their own heart, not from the mouth of the LORD.
verses.23:17: They keep on saying to those who spurn Me, 'The LORD has spoken: Peace will be yours'; and to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his heart they say, 'Disaster will not come upon you.'
verses.23:18: For who has stood in the council of the LORD so as to see and hear His word? Who has paid close attention to His word and listened?
verses.23:19: Look, the tempest of the LORD—wrath has gone out, even a whirling storm; it will whirl down upon the head of the wicked.
verses.23:20: The anger of the LORD will not turn back until He has done and accomplished the purposes of His heart; in the latter days you will understand it thoroughly.
verses.23:21: I did not send the prophets, yet they themselves ran; I did not speak to them, yet they themselves prophesied.
verses.23:22: But if they had stood in My council, then they would have made My people hear My words, and would have turned them back from their evil way and from the evil of their deeds."
verses.23:23: "Am I a God nearby," declares the LORD, "and not a God at a distance?
verses.23:24: Can a man conceal himself in hidden places so that I will not see him?" declares the LORD. "Is it not the heavens and the earth that I fill?" declares the LORD.
verses.23:25: "I have heard what the prophets have said, those who prophesy falsehood in My name, saying, 'I dreamed, I dreamed!'
verses.23:26: How long? Is this to be in the heart of the prophets who prophesy falsehood, even prophets of the deceit of their own heart,
verses.23:27: who scheme to make My people forget My name by their dreams that they recount, each to his neighbor, just as their fathers forgot My name because of Baal?
verses.23:28: Let the prophet who has a dream recount a dream, and let the one who has My word speak My word in truth. What does straw have to do with grain?" declares the LORD.
verses.23:29: "Is not My word like this—like fire," declares the LORD, "and like a hammer that shatters rock?
verses.23:30: Therefore look, I am against the prophets," declares the LORD, "who steal My words, each from his neighbor.
verses.23:31: Look, I am against the prophets," declares the LORD, "who take their own tongues and utter a declaration.
verses.23:32: Look, I am against those who prophesy dreams of falsehood," declares the LORD, "and recount them and lead My people astray by their lies and by their recklessness, when I Myself did not send them nor command them; and they bring no benefit at all to this people," declares the LORD.
verses.23:33: "Now when this people, or the prophet, or a priest asks you, saying, 'What is the burden of the LORD?' then you shall say to them, 'What burden? I will cast you off!'" declares the LORD.
verses.23:34: "As for the prophet, the priest, or the people who say, 'The burden of the LORD,' I will punish that man and his household."
verses.23:35: This is what you shall say, each to his neighbor and each to his brother: "What has the LORD answered?" and "What has the LORD spoken?"
verses.23:36: And you shall no longer mention "the burden of the LORD," for every man's own word will become the burden, and you have overturned the words of the living God, the LORD of hosts, our God.
verses.23:37: This is what you shall say to the prophet: "What has the LORD answered you?" and "What has the LORD spoken?"
verses.23:38: But if you say, "The burden of the LORD," therefore this is what the LORD says: "Because you have spoken this word, 'The burden of the LORD,' even though I sent to you, saying, 'You shall not say the burden of the LORD,'
verses.23:39: therefore look, I will completely forget you, and I will cast you off from My presence, along with the city that I gave to you and to your fathers.
verses.23:40: And I will put upon you an everlasting reproach and an everlasting humiliation that will never be forgotten."
verses.24:1: The LORD showed me, and look, two baskets of figs were set before the temple of the LORD, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had exiled Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, along with the officials of Judah and the craftsmen and the smiths, from Jerusalem and brought them to Babylon.
verses.24:2: One basket had very good figs, like first-ripe figs, and the other basket had very bad figs, which could not be eaten because of their badness.
verses.24:3: Then the LORD said to me, "What do you see, Jeremiah?" And I said, "Figs: the good figs are very good, and the bad ones are very bad, which cannot be eaten because of their badness."
verses.24:4: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying:
verses.24:5: "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Like these good figs, so I will regard for good the exiles of Judah, whom I have sent away from this place to the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.24:6: I will set My eye upon them for good, and I will bring them back to this land; I will build them up and not tear down, and I will plant them and not uproot.
verses.24:7: And I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am the LORD; and they will be a people for Me, and I Myself will be God for them, because they will turn back to Me with all their heart.
verses.24:8: But like the bad figs, which cannot be eaten because of their badness—for this is what the LORD says—so I will treat Zedekiah king of Judah, and his officials, and the remnant of Jerusalem who remain in this land, as well as those who dwell in the land of Egypt.
verses.24:9: I will make them an object of terror, a calamity to all the kingdoms of the earth—a reproach and a byword, a taunt and a curse in all the places where I will drive them.
verses.24:10: And I will send against them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, until they are completely gone from the soil that I gave to them and to their fathers."
verses.25:1: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah—that was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon—
verses.25:2: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying:
verses.25:3: "From the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day—these twenty-three years—the word of the LORD has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking, yet you have not listened.
verses.25:4: And the LORD sent to you all His servants the prophets, rising early and sending, yet you have not listened, nor have you inclined your ear to hear,
verses.25:5: saying, 'Turn back now, each one from his evil way and from the evil of your deeds, and dwell on the soil that the LORD gave to you and to your fathers from everlasting to everlasting.
verses.25:6: And do not walk after other gods to serve them and to bow down to them, and do not provoke Me to anger with the work of your hands; then I will do no harm to you.'"
verses.25:7: "Yet you have not listened to Me," declares the LORD, "so as to provoke Me to anger with the work of your hands, to your own harm."
verses.25:8: Therefore this is what the LORD of hosts says: "Because you have not listened to My words,
verses.25:9: look, I am sending and will take all the clans of the north," declares the LORD, "and will send to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, My servant, and bring them against this land, against its inhabitants, and against all these nations all around; I will devote them to destruction and make them a desolation, an object of hissing, and everlasting ruins.
verses.25:10: And I will eliminate from them the sound of rejoicing and the sound of gladness, the voice of a bridegroom and the voice of a bride, the sound of millstones and the light of a lamp.
verses.25:11: This whole land will become a ruin and a desolation, and these nations will serve the king of Babylon for seventy years.
verses.25:12: Then it will happen, when seventy years are fulfilled, that I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation," declares the LORD, "for their iniquity, along with the land of the Chaldeans, and I will make it everlasting desolations.
verses.25:13: And I will bring upon that land all My words that I have spoken against it—everything written in this scroll, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations."
verses.25:14: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, at the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying:
verses.25:15: This is what the LORD of hosts says: "Look, I am about to break the bow of Elam, the foremost of their might.
verses.25:16: And I will bring upon Elam four winds from the four ends of the heavens, and I will scatter them toward all these winds; and there will be no nation where the outcasts of Elam do not come.
verses.25:17: I will terrify Elam before their enemies and before those who seek their life; and I will bring disaster upon them, My fierce anger," declares the LORD, "and I will send the sword after them until I have consumed them.
verses.25:18: I will set My throne in Elam, and I will destroy king and officials from there," declares the LORD.
verses.25:19: "Yet it will happen in the latter days that I will restore the fortunes of Elam," declares the LORD.
verses.26:2: Concerning Egypt: regarding the army of Pharaoh Neco, king of Egypt, which was by the Euphrates River at Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, struck down in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah.
verses.26:3: Ready the small shield and the large shield, and step forward for battle.
verses.26:4: Harness the horses and mount up, horsemen; take your stand in helmets, polish the lances, put on the coats of armor.
verses.26:5: Why do I see them dismayed, retreating backward? Their mighty men are crushed, and they flee in full flight and do not look back; terror is on every side, declares the LORD.
verses.26:6: Let the swift not flee, nor the mighty warrior escape; northward, alongside the Euphrates River, they have stumbled and fallen.
verses.26:7: Who is this, rising like the Nile, whose waters churn like the rivers?
verses.26:8: Egypt rises like the Nile, and waters churn like the rivers; and he says, "I will rise up, I will cover the earth; I will destroy the city and those who dwell in it."
verses.26:9: Charge, horses, and rage wildly, chariots! Let the mighty warriors go out: Cush and Put, who handle the shield, and the Ludim, who handle and bend the bow.
verses.26:10: Yet that day belongs to the Lord GOD of hosts, a day of vengeance to avenge Himself on His adversaries. The sword will devour and have its fill, and be drenched with their blood; for there is a sacrifice for the Lord GOD of hosts in the land of the north, at the Euphrates River.
verses.26:11: Go up to Gilead and take balm, virgin daughter of Egypt. In vain you have multiplied remedies; there is no healing for you.
verses.26:12: Nations have heard of your disgrace, and your outcry has filled the earth; for warrior has stumbled against warrior, and both of them have fallen together.
verses.26:13: The word that the LORD spoke to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the coming of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, to strike the land of Egypt.
verses.26:14: Declare in Egypt and proclaim in Migdol, and proclaim in Noph and in Tahpanhes. Say, "Take your stand and prepare yourself, for the sword has devoured all around you."
verses.26:15: Why has your mighty one been swept away? He did not stand, for the LORD thrust him down.
verses.26:16: He has made many stumble; indeed, a man has fallen against his companion, and they said, "Arise, and let us return to our people and to the land of our birth, away from the oppressing sword."
verses.26:17: They cried out there, "Pharaoh, king of Egypt, is a loud noise; he has let the appointed time pass by."
verses.26:18: As I live, declares the King—the LORD of hosts is His name—surely like Tabor among the mountains and like Carmel by the sea, he will come.
verses.26:19: Make ready for yourself baggage for exile, inhabitant, daughter of Egypt; for Noph will become a desolation, laid in ruins, without an inhabitant.
verses.26:20: Egypt is a very beautiful heifer; a gadfly from the north has come—it has come!
verses.26:21: Her mercenaries in her midst are also like fattened calves; for they too have turned back, they have fled together, they did not stand, because the day of their calamity has come upon them, the time of their punishment.
verses.26:22: Her sound moves like that of a serpent, for they march in force, and with axes they have come against her like cutters of wood.
verses.26:23: They have cut down her forest, declares the LORD, though it cannot be searched out; for they are more numerous than locusts, and they are without number.
verses.26:24: The daughter of Egypt has been put to shame; she has been given into the hand of a northern people.
verses.26:25: The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, has said, "Look, I am about to punish Amon of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, and her gods, and her kings—even Pharaoh and those who trust in him."
verses.26:27: But you, do not fear, My servant Jacob, and do not be dismayed, Israel; for look, I am about to save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return and be quiet and at ease, and no one will frighten him.
verses.26:28: As for you, do not fear, My servant Jacob, declares the LORD, for I am with you. For I will make a complete end of all the nations to which I have banished you, yet of you I will not make a complete end; I will discipline you in justice, and I will by no means let you go unpunished.
verses.27:1: The word that the LORD spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, through Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.27:2: Declare among the nations and proclaim, and lift up a banner; proclaim, do not conceal it! Say, "Babylon has been captured, Bel has been put to shame, Merodach has been shattered; her images have been put to shame, her idols have been shattered."
verses.27:3: For a nation has come up against her from the north; it will make her land a desolation, and there will be no inhabitant in it. From human to beast, they have fled, they have gone.
verses.27:4: In those days and at that time, declares the LORD, the sons of Israel will come, they and the sons of Judah together; walking along and weeping as they go, they will seek the LORD their God.
verses.27:5: They will ask the way to Zion, with their faces turned in this direction: "Come and join yourselves to the LORD in an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten."
verses.27:6: My people have become lost sheep. Their shepherds have led them astray; they have turned them aside on the mountains. They have gone from mountain to hill; they have forgotten their resting place.
verses.27:7: All who found them devoured them, and their adversaries said, "We are not guilty, because they have sinned against the LORD, the pasture of righteousness and the hope of their fathers—the LORD."
verses.27:8: Flee from the midst of Babylon, and go out from the land of the Chaldeans; be like male goats in front of the flock.
verses.27:9: For look, I am stirring up and bringing against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the land of the north. They will draw up in battle array against her; from there she will be captured. Its arrows are like a skilled warrior who does not return empty-handed.
verses.27:10: Chaldea will become plunder; all her plunderers will be satisfied, declares the LORD.
verses.27:11: Though you are glad, though you exult, pillagers of My inheritance, though you prance like a threshing heifer and neigh like stallions,
verses.27:12: your mother will be deeply ashamed; she who bore you will be disgraced. Look, she will be the last of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
verses.27:13: Because of the wrath of the LORD she will not be inhabited, but all of her will become a desolation. Everyone who passes by Babylon will be appalled and hiss at all her wounds.
verses.27:14: Draw up in battle array against Babylon on every side, all you who bend the bow! Shoot at her, spare no arrow, for she has sinned against the LORD.
verses.27:15: Raise a battle shout against her on every side! She has surrendered; her bulwarks have fallen, her walls have been torn down. For this is the vengeance of the LORD: take vengeance on her; as she has done, do to her.
verses.27:16: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and the one who handles the sickle at harvest time. Because of the oppressing sword, each one will turn to his people, and each one will flee to his land.
verses.27:17: Israel is a scattered sheep; lions have driven him away. The first one, the king of Assyria, devoured him, and this last one, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, has gnawed his bones.
verses.27:18: Therefore, this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "Look, I am about to punish the king of Babylon and his land, just as I punished the king of Assyria.
verses.27:19: And I will bring Israel back to his pasture, and he will graze on Carmel and Bashan; on the hill country of Ephraim and in Gilead his soul will be satisfied.
verses.27:20: In those days and at that time, declares the LORD, the iniquity of Israel will be sought, and there will be none, and the sins of Judah, and they will not be found; for I will pardon those whom I leave remaining."
verses.27:21: Against the land of Merathaim—go up against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod! Kill and devote to destruction in pursuit of them, declares the LORD, and do according to all that I have commanded you.
verses.27:22: The sound of battle is in the land, and great shattering!
verses.27:23: How the hammer of the whole earth has been cut down and shattered! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!
verses.27:24: I set a snare for you and you were indeed captured, Babylon, though you did not know it; you were found and also seized, because you contended against the LORD.
verses.27:25: The LORD has opened His storehouse and brought out the weapons of His indignation; for the Lord GOD of hosts has a work in the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.27:26: Come against her from the farthest border; open up her granaries, pile her up like heaps, and devote her to destruction; let there be no remnant for her.
verses.27:27: Put all her bulls to the sword; let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them, for their day has come, the time of their punishment.
verses.27:28: The sound of fugitives and escapees from the land of Babylon—to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance for His temple!
verses.27:29: Summon archers against Babylon, all who bend the bow! Encamp against her on every side; let there be no escape for her. Repay her according to her work; according to all that she has done, do to her, for she has acted arrogantly against the LORD, against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.27:30: Therefore her young men will fall in her open squares, and all her men of war will be silenced on that day, declares the LORD.
verses.27:31: Look, I am against you, Arrogant One, declares the Lord GOD of hosts, for your day has come, the time when I punish you.
verses.27:32: The arrogant one will stumble and fall, with no one to raise him up; and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it will devour all that surrounds him.
verses.27:33: This is what the LORD of hosts says: "The sons of Israel and the sons of Judah are oppressed together; all who took them captive have held fast to them; they have refused to let them go.
verses.27:34: Their Redeemer is strong; the LORD of hosts is His name. He will vigorously plead their case, in order to give rest to the earth, but bring unrest to the inhabitants of Babylon."
verses.27:35: A sword against the Chaldeans, declares the LORD, and against the inhabitants of Babylon, and against her officials, and against her wise men!
verses.27:36: A sword against the diviners, and they will become fools! A sword against her mighty warriors, and they will be dismayed!
verses.27:37: A sword against his horses and against his chariots, and against all the mixed troops who are in her midst, and they will become like women! A sword against her treasuries, and they will be looted!
verses.27:38: A drought against her waters, and they will dry up! For it is a land of carved images, and over terrifying idols they go mad.
verses.27:39: Therefore desert creatures will dwell with hyenas, and ostriches will dwell in her. Never again will she be inhabited, nor will she be settled from generation to generation.
verses.27:40: As in God's overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighboring towns, declares the LORD, no man will dwell there, nor will any son of man reside in her.
verses.27:41: Look, a people is coming from the north, and a great nation and many kings are being stirred up from the farthest parts of the earth.
verses.27:42: They grasp bow and javelin; they are cruel and have no compassion. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on horses, arrayed like a man for battle against you, daughter of Babylon.
verses.27:43: The king of Babylon has heard the report of them, and his hands have gone limp; distress has gripped him, anguish like a woman in labor.
verses.27:44: Look, like a lion he will come up from the thicket of the Jordan against a perennial pasture; for in an instant I will make them run away from her, and whoever is chosen I will appoint over her. For who is like Me, and who will summon Me? And who is this shepherd who can stand before Me?
verses.27:45: Therefore hear the plan of the LORD that He has planned against Babylon, and His purposes that He has purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: surely they will drag them off, the little ones of the flock; surely the pasture will be appalled over them!
verses.27:46: At the cry, "Babylon has been seized!" the earth quakes, and an outcry is heard among the nations.
verses.28:1: This is what the LORD says: "Look, I am rousing a destroying wind against Babylon and against the residents of Leb-kamai.
verses.28:2: And I will send foreigners to Babylon, and they will winnow her and empty her land; for they will be against her from every side in the day of disaster.
verses.28:3: Do not let the archer bend his bow, nor let him lift himself up in his armor; and do not spare her young men; devote her entire army to destruction.
verses.28:4: And those mortally wounded will fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and those pierced through in her streets."
verses.28:5: For neither Israel nor Judah has been left widowed by his God, by the LORD of hosts, even though their land is filled with guilt against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.28:6: Flee from the midst of Babylon, and let each one rescue his own life! Do not be cut off in her iniquity, for it is a time of vengeance for the LORD; He is repaying recompense to her.
verses.28:7: Babylon was a cup of gold in the hand of the LORD, making the entire earth drunk; from her wine nations drank, therefore nations act madly.
verses.28:8: Suddenly Babylon fell and was shattered! Wail over her; get balm for her suffering, perhaps she will be healed.
verses.28:9: "We tried to heal Babylon, yet she was not healed. Abandon her, and let each of us go to his own land, for her judgment has reached to the heavens and has been lifted up to the clouds."
verses.28:10: "The LORD has brought forth our vindication; come, and let us tell in Zion the work of the LORD our God."
verses.28:11: Polish the arrows, fill the quivers! The LORD has roused the spirit of the kings of Media, for His purpose is against Babylon, to destroy her; for this is the vengeance of the LORD, the vengeance for His temple.
verses.28:12: Against the walls of Babylon raise a standard! Strengthen the watch, station watchmen, prepare the ambushers! For the LORD has both purposed and done what He spoke against the residents of Babylon.
verses.28:13: You who dwell beside many waters, abundant in treasures, your end has come, the measure of your cutting off.
verses.28:14: The LORD of hosts has sworn by Himself: "Surely I will fill you with men like locusts, and they will raise a battle shout over you."
verses.28:15: He is the One who made the earth by His strength, who set the world firm by His wisdom, and by His understanding He stretched out the heavens.
verses.28:16: When He gives His voice, there is a roaring of waters in the heavens, and He causes clouds to rise from the end of the earth; He makes lightning flashes for the rain and brings out wind from His storehouses.
verses.28:17: Every person is senseless, devoid of knowledge; every metalworker is disgraced by a carved image, for his cast image is a lie, and there is no breath in them.
verses.28:18: They are emptiness, a work of mockery; at the time of their reckoning they will perish.
verses.28:19: Not like these is the portion of Jacob, for He is the Former of all things, and the tribe of His inheritance; the LORD of hosts is His name.
verses.28:20: "You are a war club to Me, weapons of war; and with you I dash to pieces nations, and with you I destroy kingdoms;
verses.28:21: and with you I dash to pieces horse and its rider, and with you I dash to pieces chariot and its rider;
verses.28:22: and with you I dash to pieces man and woman, and with you I dash to pieces old man and boy, and with you I dash to pieces young man and virgin;
verses.28:23: and with you I dash to pieces shepherd and his flock, and with you I dash to pieces plowman and his team, and with you I dash to pieces governors and officials.
verses.28:24: And I will repay Babylon and all the residents of Chaldea for all their evil that they did in Zion, before your eyes," declares the LORD.
verses.28:25: "Look, I am against you, destroying mountain," declares the LORD, "who destroys all the earth; and I will stretch out My hand against you, roll you down from the cliffs, and make you into a mountain of burning.
verses.28:26: And they will not take from you a stone for a corner or a stone for foundations, for you will be everlasting desolations," declares the LORD.
verses.28:27: Raise a standard in the land, blow a ram's horn among the nations! Consecrate nations against her; summon the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz against her. Appoint a commander against her; send up horses like bristling locusts!
verses.28:28: Consecrate nations against her: the kings of Media, her governors and all her officials, and every land of his dominion.
verses.28:29: And the earth quakes and writhes, for the plans of the LORD stand firm against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation with no inhabitant.
verses.28:30: The mighty men of Babylon have stopped fighting; they stay in the strongholds; their might has dried up; they have become women; her dwellings are set ablaze; her bars are shattered.
verses.28:31: Runner runs to meet runner, and messenger to meet messenger, to report to the king of Babylon that his city has been captured from every quarter;
verses.28:32: and the crossings have been seized, the reed marshes are burned with fire, and the men of war are panicked.
verses.28:33: For this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "Daughter Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time of trampling it; a little while longer, and the time of the harvest will come for her."
verses.28:34: "Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has devoured me, he has crushed me; he has placed me as an empty vessel; he has swallowed me like a sea monster; he has filled his belly with my delicacies; he has flushed me away.
verses.28:35: May the violence against me and my flesh be upon Babylon," she who dwells in Zion will say; "and may my blood be against the residents of Chaldea," Jerusalem will say.
verses.28:36: Therefore this is what the LORD says: "Look, I am arguing your case and will take vengeance for you; and I will dry up her sea and parch her spring.
verses.28:37: And Babylon will become heaps of rubble, a lair of jackals, a desolation and an object of hissing, with no inhabitant.
verses.28:38: Together they roar like young lions; they growl like cubs of lions.
verses.28:39: While they are heated, I will set out their banquet and make them drunk, so that they revel, and then sleep an everlasting sleep and not wake up," declares the LORD.
verses.28:40: "I will bring them down like lambs to be slaughtered, like rams along with male goats."
verses.28:41: How Sheshach has been captured, and the praise of all the earth seized! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!
verses.28:42: The sea has risen over Babylon; she has been covered by the tumult of its waves.
verses.28:43: Her cities have become a desolation, a dry land and a desert plain, a land where no person lives and through which no human being passes.
verses.28:44: "And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and bring what he has swallowed out of his mouth; and nations will no longer stream to him. Even the wall of Babylon has fallen!"
verses.28:49: Babylon also must fall for the mortally wounded of Israel, just as on account of Babylon the mortally wounded of all the earth have fallen.
verses.28:50: Survivors from the sword, go, do not stop! Remember the LORD from a distance, and let Jerusalem come into your heart.
verses.28:51: "We are ashamed, for we have heard insult; disgrace has covered our faces, because foreigners have come into the sanctuaries of the house of the LORD."
verses.28:52: "Therefore, look, days are coming," declares the LORD, "when I will punish her carved images, and across all her land the mortally wounded will groan.
verses.28:53: Even if Babylon rises to the heavens, and even if she fortifies the height of her strength, devastators will come to her from Me," declares the LORD.
verses.28:54: A sound of outcry from Babylon, and a great shattering from the land of the Chaldeans!
verses.28:55: For the LORD is devastating Babylon, and He will wipe out the loud voice from her; and their waves will roar like many waters; the uproar of their voice is sounded forth.
verses.28:56: For a devastator has come against her, against Babylon, and her mighty men are captured; their bows are broken, for the LORD is a God of recompenses; He will certainly repay.
verses.28:57: "And I will make her princes and her wise men drunk, her governors, her officials, and her mighty men; and they will sleep an everlasting sleep and not wake up," declares the King—the LORD of hosts is His name.
verses.28:58: This is what the LORD of hosts says: "The broad walls of Babylon will be utterly razed, and her lofty gates will burn with fire; so peoples will labor for emptiness, and nations for fire, and they will grow weary."
verses.28:59: The word that Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah son of Neriah, son of Mahseiah, when he went to Babylon with Zedekiah king of Judah in the fourth year of his reign; now Seraiah was quartermaster.
verses.28:60: And Jeremiah wrote in one scroll all the disaster that would come against Babylon, all these words that are written against Babylon.
verses.28:61: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, "When you arrive in Babylon, see to it that you read all these words,
verses.28:62: and say, 'LORD, You Yourself have spoken against this place to cut it off, so that no inhabitant remains in it, from human to beast, for it will be everlasting desolations.'
verses.28:63: And it will be that when you finish reading this scroll, you will bind a stone to it and cast it into the middle of the Euphrates,
verses.28:64: and say, 'In this way Babylon will sink and not rise because of the disaster that I am bringing upon her, and they will grow weary.'" To this point are the words of Jeremiah.
verses.29:1: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet regarding the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck Gaza.
verses.29:2: This is what the LORD says: "Look, waters are rising from the north and will become a sweeping torrent; they will sweep over the land and its fullness, the city and those dwelling in it. People will cry out, and everyone dwelling in the land will wail.
verses.29:3: At the sound of the pounding hooves of his stallions, at the rumbling of his chariots, the tumult of his wheels, fathers do not turn back to their children from feebleness of hands,
verses.29:4: on account of the day that is coming to devastate all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every surviving helper; for the LORD is devastating the Philistines, the remnant of the coastland of Caphtor.
verses.29:5: Baldness has come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is ruined. Remnant of their valley, how long will you gash yourself?"
verses.29:6: Alas, sword of the LORD! How long will you not be quiet? Withdraw into your sheath; rest and be silent!
verses.29:7: How can you be quiet when the LORD has commanded it? Against Ashkelon and against the shore of the sea—there He has appointed it.
verses.30:1: Concerning Edom. This is what the LORD of hosts says: "Is wisdom no longer in Teman? Has counsel perished from the discerning? Has their wisdom decayed?
verses.30:2: Flee, turn back, go deep to dwell, inhabitants of Dedan, for I will bring the disaster of Esau upon him, the time when I punish him.
verses.30:3: If grape harvesters came to you, would they not leave gleanings? If thieves came by night, they would destroy what suffices for them.
verses.30:4: But I have laid Esau bare; I have uncovered his hiding places, and he is unable to hide himself. His seed, his brothers, and his neighbors are devastated, and he is no more.
verses.30:5: Leave your fatherless children; I will preserve them alive, and let your widows trust in Me."
verses.30:6: For this is what the LORD says: "Look, those whose sentence was not to drink the cup must surely drink it, and are you the one to go completely unpunished? You will not go unpunished, for you will surely drink it!
verses.30:7: For I have sworn by Myself, declares the LORD, that Bozrah will become a horror, a reproach, a ruin, and a curse, and all her cities will become perpetual ruins."
verses.30:8: I have heard a report from the LORD, and an envoy has been sent among the nations: "Gather together and come against her, and rise up for battle!"
verses.30:9: "For look, I have made you small among the nations, despised among mankind.
verses.30:10: The dread you inspire has deceived you, the arrogance of your heart, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, who occupy the height of the hill. Though you set your nest as high as the eagle, from there I will bring you down, declares the LORD.
verses.30:11: Edom will become a horror; everyone passing by her will be horrified and will hiss at all her wounds.
verses.30:12: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighbors, says the LORD, no one will dwell there, and no human being will sojourn in her.
verses.30:13: Look, like a lion one will come up from the thicket of the Jordan against an enduring pasture; for in a moment I will make him run away from her, and whoever is chosen I will appoint over her. For who is like Me, and who will summon Me? And who is the shepherd who can stand before Me?"
verses.30:14: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD that He has devised against Edom, and His designs that He has conceived against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the little ones of the flock will drag them away; surely their pasture will be appalled at them.
verses.30:15: At the sound of their fall the earth quakes; an outcry—its sound is heard at the Sea of Reeds.
verses.30:16: Look, like an eagle he will soar up and swoop, and spread his wings over Bozrah; and the heart of the warriors of Edom in that day will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
verses.30:17: Concerning the sons of Ammon. This is what the LORD says: "Does Israel have no sons? Or has he no heir? Why then has Malcam taken possession of Gad, and his people dwelt in his cities?
verses.30:18: Therefore look, days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will cause the alarm of war to be heard against Rabbah of the sons of Ammon; she will become a mound of desolation, and her villages will be set on fire, and Israel will dispossess his dispossessors, says the LORD.
verses.30:19: Wail, Heshbon, for Ai is devastated! Cry out, daughters of Rabbah! Wrap yourselves in sackcloth, lament, and rush back and forth among the enclosures, for Malcam will go into exile, his priests and his officials together.
verses.30:20: Why do you boast in the valleys—your valley flows away—wayward daughter who trusts in her treasures: 'Who will come against me?'
verses.30:21: Look, I am bringing terror upon you, declares the Lord GOD of hosts, from all around you; and you will be driven out, each one straight ahead, and there will be no one to gather the fugitive."
verses.30:23: Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck. This is what the LORD says: "Rise, go up against Kedar, and devastate the sons of the east!
verses.30:24: They will take their tents and their flocks; they will carry off for themselves their tent curtains, all their equipment, and their camels, and they will cry out to them, 'Terror on every side!'
verses.30:25: Flee, wander far away, go deep to dwell, inhabitants of Hazor, declares the LORD, for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has devised a plan against you and conceived a design against you.
verses.30:26: Rise, go up against a nation at ease, dwelling in security, declares the LORD; it has neither gates nor bars; they live alone.
verses.30:27: Their camels will become plunder, and the multitude of their livestock spoil. I will scatter them to every wind, those who clip the edges of their hair, and from every side of it I will bring their disaster, declares the LORD.
verses.30:28: Hazor will become a den of jackals, a desolation forever; no one will dwell there, and no human being will sojourn in her."
verses.30:29: Concerning Damascus. Hamath and Arpad are put to shame, for they have heard a bad report; they have melted away. There is anxiety on the sea; it cannot be quiet.
verses.30:30: Damascus has grown feeble; she has turned to flee, and trembling has gripped her. Anguish and birth pangs have seized her like a woman giving birth.
verses.30:31: How has the city of praise not been abandoned, the town of my joy!
verses.30:32: "Therefore her young men will fall in her squares, and all the men of war will be silenced in that day, declares the LORD of hosts.
verses.30:33: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it will devour the citadels of Ben-hadad."
verses.31:1: Concerning Moab. This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "Woe upon Nebo, for it is devastated! Kiriathaim is put to shame, captured; the high fortress is put to shame and dismayed.
verses.31:2: The praise of Moab is no more; in Heshbon they have plotted disaster against her: 'Come, let us cut her off from being a nation!' You also, Madmen, will be silenced; a sword will follow behind you.
verses.31:3: A sound of outcry from Horonaim: devastation and great ruin!
verses.31:4: Moab is shattered; her little ones have made an outcry heard.
verses.31:5: For on the ascent of Luhith weeping goes up with weeping; for on the descent of Horonaim they have heard the anguished outcry of ruin.
verses.31:6: Flee, rescue your lives, and become like a shrub in the wilderness!
verses.31:7: For because of your trust in your works and in your treasuries, you also will be captured; and Chemosh will go out into exile, his priests and his officials together.
verses.31:8: A devastator will come against every city, and no city will escape; the valley will perish and the plateau will be destroyed, as the LORD has spoken.
verses.31:9: Give wings to Moab, for in flight she will depart; and her cities will become a desolation, with no one dwelling in them.
verses.31:10: Cursed is the one who does the work of the LORD with negligence, and cursed is the one who holds back his sword from blood!
verses.31:11: Moab has been undisturbed from his youth, and he has rested on his dregs; he has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, nor has he gone into exile. Therefore his flavor has remained in him, and his aroma has not changed.
verses.31:12: Therefore look, days are coming," declares the LORD, "when I will send tilters against him, and they will tip him over; they will empty his vessels and smash their jars.
verses.31:13: And Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, just as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their reliance.
verses.31:14: How can you say, 'We are warriors, and men of valor for battle'?
verses.31:15: Moab is devastated, and one has gone up against her cities; and the choicest of his young men have gone down to the slaughter," declares the King—the LORD of hosts is His name.
verses.31:16: "The calamity of Moab is close to coming, and his disaster hurries very quickly.
verses.31:17: Mourn for him, all you around him, and all you who know his name; say, 'How the scepter of strength is broken, the staff of splendor!'
verses.31:18: Come down from glory and sit in thirst, inhabitant of daughter Dibon; for the devastator of Moab has come up against you, he has ruined your fortresses.
verses.31:19: Stand by the road and keep watch, inhabitant of Aroer; ask the man who flees and the woman who escapes, say, 'What has happened?'
verses.31:20: Moab is put to shame, for it is dismayed. Wail and cry out! Declare by the Arnon that Moab is devastated.
verses.31:21: And judgment has come upon the land of the plateau: upon Holon, upon Jahzah, upon Mephaath,
verses.31:22: upon Dibon, upon Nebo, upon Beth-diblathaim,
verses.31:23: upon Kiriathaim, upon Beth-gamul, upon Beth-meon,
verses.31:24: upon Kerioth, upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far and near.
verses.31:25: The horn of Moab has been hacked off, and his arm is broken," declares the LORD.
verses.31:26: "Make him drunk, for he has exalted himself against the LORD; so Moab will wallow in his vomit, and he too will become a laughingstock.
verses.31:27: Was not Israel a laughingstock to you? Was he found among thieves, that as often as you speak about him you shake your head?
verses.31:28: Abandon the cities and dwell in the cliffs, inhabitants of Moab, and be like a dove that nests along the sides of the mouth of a pit.
verses.31:29: We have heard of the pride of Moab—exceedingly proud is he—his loftiness, his pride, his arrogance, and the haughtiness of his heart.
verses.31:30: I know," declares the LORD, "his insolence, yet it is empty; his boasts have achieved nothing.
verses.31:31: Therefore I will wail over Moab, and for all of Moab I will cry out; for the men of Kir-heres there will be moaning.
verses.31:32: More than the weeping for Jazer I will weep for you, vine of Sibmah! Your tendrils crossed over the sea; they reached to the sea of Jazer. Upon your summer fruit and upon your grape harvest a devastator has fallen.
verses.31:33: Gladness and joy have been taken away from the orchard and from the land of Moab; I have caused wine to cease from the winepresses. No one will tread with the harvest shout; the shouting will not be a harvest shout.
verses.31:34: From the outcry of Heshbon as far as Elealeh, even to Jahaz they have raised their voice, from Zoar to Horonaim and Eglath-shelishiyah; for even the waters of Nimrim will become desolations.
verses.31:35: And I will bring to an end in Moab," declares the LORD, "the one who offers on a high place and the one who burns incense to his gods.
verses.31:36: Therefore My heart moans for Moab like flutes, and My heart moans like flutes for the men of Kir-heres; therefore the wealth he acquired has perished.
verses.31:37: For every head is shaved bald and every beard is clipped; on all hands are gashes, and on the waist is sackcloth.
verses.31:38: On all the rooftops of Moab and in her squares, everywhere is lamentation; for I have shattered Moab like a vessel in which there is no delight," declares the LORD.
verses.31:39: "How it is dismayed! Wail! How Moab has turned his back in shame! So Moab will become a laughingstock and an object of terror to all around him."
verses.31:40: For this is what the LORD says: "Look, like an eagle he will swoop down and spread out his wings against Moab.
verses.31:41: The towns are captured, and the strongholds are seized; and the heart of the warriors of Moab on that day will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
verses.31:42: Moab will be destroyed from being a people, because he has exalted himself against the LORD.
verses.31:43: Terror and pit and snare are upon you, inhabitant of Moab," declares the LORD.
verses.31:44: "The one who flees from the terror will fall into the pit, and the one who climbs out of the pit will be caught in the snare; for I will bring upon her, upon Moab, the year of their punishment," declares the LORD.
verses.32:15: For this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, said to me: "Take this cup of the wine of wrath from My hand, and make all the nations to whom I am sending you drink it.
verses.32:16: They will drink and reel and go mad because of the sword that I am sending among them."
verses.32:17: So I took the cup from the hand of the LORD and made all the nations drink to whom the LORD had sent me:
verses.32:18: Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, its kings and its officials, to make them a ruin, a desolation, an object of hissing, and a curse, as it is this day;
verses.32:19: Pharaoh king of Egypt, his servants, his officials, and all his people;
verses.32:20: and all the mixed peoples, all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;
verses.32:21: Edom, Moab, and the sons of Ammon;
verses.32:22: all the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the coastland across the sea;
verses.32:23: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who trim the edges of their hair;
verses.32:24: all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mixed peoples who dwell in the wilderness;
verses.32:25: all the kings of Zimri, all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of Media;
verses.32:26: and all the kings of the north, near and far, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the earth that are on the face of the ground. And the king of Sheshach will drink after them.
verses.32:27: And you shall say to them, "This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: 'Drink, get drunk, and vomit; fall and do not rise, because of the sword that I am sending among you.'"
verses.32:28: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup from your hand to drink, that you shall say to them, "This is what the LORD of hosts says: 'You shall certainly drink!
verses.32:29: For look, in the city upon which My name is called I am beginning to bring harm, and shall you really go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, for I am summoning a sword against all the inhabitants of the earth,' declares the LORD of hosts."
verses.32:30: And you shall prophesy against them all these words, and say to them: "The LORD will roar from on high, and from His holy dwelling He will utter His voice; He will roar mightily against His fold. He will shout a harvest cry like those who tread grapes against all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.32:31: A clamor has come to the end of the earth, for the LORD has a dispute with the nations; He is entering into judgment with all flesh. As for the wicked, He has given them to the sword," declares the LORD.
verses.32:32: This is what the LORD of hosts says: "Look, disaster is going forth from nation to nation, and a great tempest is being stirred up from the farthest reaches of the earth.
verses.32:33: And those killed by the LORD on that day will be from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. They will not be lamented, nor gathered, nor buried; they will become dung on the face of the ground.
verses.32:34: Wail, shepherds, and cry out! Roll in ashes, lords of the flock! For your days for slaughter and your dispersions have been fulfilled, and you will fall like a precious vessel.
verses.32:35: Flight will perish from the shepherds, and escape from the lords of the flock.
verses.32:36: The sound of the outcry of the shepherds, and the wailing of the lords of the flock! For the LORD is devastating their pasture,
verses.32:37: and the peaceful folds are silenced because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
verses.32:38: Like a young lion He has left His lair, for their land has become a desolation because of the fierceness of the oppressor and because of His fierce anger."
verses.33:1: At the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came from the LORD, saying,
verses.33:2: "This is what the LORD says: Stand in the courtyard of the house of the LORD, and speak to all the cities of Judah who come to worship at the house of the LORD all the words that I have commanded you to speak to them; do not leave out a word.
verses.33:3: Perhaps they will listen and turn back, each person from his evil way, and I will relent concerning the disaster that I am planning to do to them because of the evil of their deeds.
verses.33:4: And you shall say to them, 'This is what the LORD says: If you do not listen to Me, to walk in My law that I have placed before you,
verses.33:5: to listen to the words of My servants the prophets, whom I am sending to you, rising early and sending, though you have not listened,
verses.33:6: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and this city I will turn into a curse for all the nations of the earth.'"
verses.33:7: And the priests, the prophets, and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.
verses.33:8: Now it happened, when Jeremiah finished speaking everything that the LORD had commanded him to speak to all the people, that the priests, the prophets, and all the people seized him, saying, "You shall surely die!
verses.33:9: Why have you prophesied in the name of the LORD, saying, 'This house will become like Shiloh, and this city will lie in ruins, with no inhabitant'?" Then all the people assembled around Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.
verses.33:10: And the officials of Judah heard of these matters, and they went up from the house of the king to the house of the LORD and sat at the entrance of the New Gate of the LORD.
verses.33:11: Then the priests and the prophets spoke to the officials and to all the people, saying, "A judgment of death is due this man, for he has prophesied against this city, just as you have heard with your own ears."
verses.33:12: And Jeremiah addressed all the officials and all the people, saying, "It was the LORD who sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.
verses.33:13: So now, make your ways and your deeds good, and listen to the voice of the LORD your God, and the LORD will relent concerning the disaster that He has spoken against you.
verses.33:14: As for me, here I am in your hand; do to me according to what is good and right in your eyes.
verses.33:15: Only be completely sure that if you put me to death, you are placing innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon its inhabitants; for in truth the LORD has sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears."
verses.33:16: Then the officials and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets, "No judgment of death is due this man, for in the name of the LORD our God he has spoken to us."
verses.33:17: And some men from among the elders of the land stood up and spoke to the entire assembly of the people, saying,
verses.33:18: "Micah the Morashtite was prophesying in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and he spoke to all the people of Judah, saying, 'This is what the LORD of hosts says: Zion will be plowed into a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of ruins, and the mountain of the house will become high places of a forest.'
verses.33:19: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah actually put him to death? Did he not fear the LORD and seek the favor of the LORD, and the LORD relented concerning the disaster that He had spoken against them? Yet we are doing great harm against our own lives."
verses.33:20: There was also a man prophesying in the name of the LORD, Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath-jearim, and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.
verses.33:21: And King Jehoiakim, along with all his mighty men and all the officials, heard his words, and the king sought to put him to death; when Uriah heard of it, he became afraid and fled, and he came to Egypt.
verses.33:22: So King Jehoiakim sent men to Egypt, Elnathan son of Achbor and men with him into Egypt.
verses.33:23: And they brought Uriah out of Egypt and took him to King Jehoiakim, who struck him down with the sword and threw his corpse into the graves of the common people.
verses.33:24: However, the hand of Ahikam son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so that he would not be given into the hand of the people to put him to death.
verses.34:2: This is what the LORD said to me: "Make straps and yoke bars for yourself, and place them on your neck,
verses.34:3: and send them to the king of Edom, to the king of Moab, to the king of the sons of Ammon, to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon by the hand of the messengers coming to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.
verses.34:4: And command them for their masters, saying, 'This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Thus you shall say to your masters:
verses.34:5: I Myself made the earth, mankind, and the animals that are upon the face of the earth, by My great strength and by My outstretched arm, and I give it to the one who is right in My eyes.
verses.34:6: And now, I Myself have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, My servant, and the wild beasts of the field as well I have given to him to serve him.
verses.34:8: And it will be that the nation and the kingdom that will not serve him, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and that will not place its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon—with the sword, with famine, and with pestilence I will punish that nation, declares the LORD, until I have consumed them by his hand.
verses.34:9: As for you, do not listen to your prophets, to your diviners, to your dreams, to your fortune-tellers, or to your sorcerers, who are speaking to you, saying, "You will not serve the king of Babylon."
verses.34:10: For a lie is what they are prophesying to you, so as to remove you far away from your own land, and I will banish you, and you will perish.
verses.34:11: But the nation that brings its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serves him—I will leave it upon its own land, declares the LORD, and it will cultivate it and live in it.'"
verses.34:12: And to Zedekiah king of Judah I spoke according to all these words, saying, "Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, serve him and his people, and live.
verses.34:14: And do not listen to the words of the prophets who are telling you, 'You will not serve the king of Babylon,' for a lie is what they are prophesying to you.
verses.34:15: For I did not send them, declares the LORD, yet they are prophesying falsely in My name, so that I will banish you and you will perish, you and the prophets who prophesy to you."
verses.34:16: And to the priests and to all this people I spoke, saying, "This is what the LORD says: Do not listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, 'Look, the vessels of the house of the LORD are now about to be brought back swiftly from Babylon,' for a lie is what they are prophesying to you.
verses.34:18: And if they are prophets, and if the word of the LORD is with them, let them now plead with the LORD of hosts so that the vessels remaining in the house of the LORD, and in the house of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem will not go to Babylon.
verses.34:19: For this is what the LORD of hosts says concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the stands, and concerning the rest of the vessels remaining in this city,
verses.34:20: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take when he exiled Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, from Jerusalem to Babylon, together with all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem:
verses.34:22: To Babylon they will be brought, and there they will stay until the day I attend to them, declares the LORD; then I will bring them up and restore them to this place."
verses.35:1: Now it happened in that same year, at the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, that Hananiah son of Azzur, the prophet who was from Gibeon, spoke to me in the house of the LORD in the sight of the priests and all the people, saying,
verses.35:2: "This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, has spoken, saying: 'I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.35:3: Within two full years I am bringing back to this place all the vessels of the house of the LORD, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took from this place and brought to Babylon.
verses.35:4: And Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, together with all the exiles of Judah who went to Babylon, I am bringing back to this place,' declares the LORD, 'for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.'"
verses.35:5: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Hananiah the prophet in the sight of the priests and in the sight of all the people who were standing in the house of the LORD.
verses.35:6: And Jeremiah the prophet said, "Amen! So may the LORD do! May the LORD establish your words that you have prophesied, to bring back the vessels of the house of the LORD and all the exiles from Babylon to this place.
verses.35:7: Only listen now to this word that I am speaking in your ears and in the ears of all the people:
verses.35:8: The prophets who were before me and before you from long ago prophesied against many lands and against great kingdoms, concerning war, disaster, and pestilence.
verses.35:9: As for the prophet who prophesies concerning peace, when the word of the prophet comes about, that prophet will be known as one whom the LORD has sent in truth."
verses.35:10: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke bar off the neck of Jeremiah the prophet and broke it.
verses.35:11: And Hananiah spoke in the sight of all the people, saying, "This is what the LORD says: Like this I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, within two full years, off the neck of all the nations." And Jeremiah the prophet went on his way.
verses.35:12: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, after Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke bar off the neck of Jeremiah the prophet, saying,
verses.35:13: "Go and tell Hananiah, saying, 'This is what the LORD says: Yoke bars of wood you have broken, and in their place you have made yoke bars of iron.
verses.35:14: For this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: A yoke of iron I have placed upon the neck of all these nations to serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and they will serve him; and even the wild beasts of the field I have given to him.'"
verses.35:15: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Hananiah the prophet: "Hear now, Hananiah! The LORD has not sent you, yet you have caused this people to trust in a lie.
verses.35:16: Therefore, this is what the LORD says: Look, I am sending you off from the face of the earth; this year you will die, because you have spoken rebellion against the LORD."
verses.35:17: And Hananiah the prophet died in that year, in the seventh month.
verses.36:1: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the remnant of the elders of the exiles, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had exiled from Jerusalem to Babylon,
verses.36:2: after Jeconiah the king and the queen mother, the court officials, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the craftsmen and the smiths had gone out from Jerusalem,
verses.36:3: by the hand of Elasah son of Shaphan and Gemariah son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, to Babylon, saying:
verses.36:4: "This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says to all the exiles whom I have exiled from Jerusalem to Babylon:
verses.36:5: Build houses and dwell in them, and plant gardens and eat their fruit.
verses.36:6: Take wives and father sons and daughters; take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; and multiply there, and do not decrease.
verses.36:7: And seek the peace of the city to which I have exiled you, and pray to the LORD on its behalf, for in its peace you will have peace.
verses.36:8: For this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Do not let your prophets who are among you and your diviners deceive you, and do not listen to your dreams that you cause to be dreamed;
verses.36:9: for they are prophesying falsely to you in My name; I did not send them, declares the LORD.
verses.36:10: For this is what the LORD says: When seventy years have been completed for Babylon, I will attend to you, and I will establish My good word toward you, to bring you back to this place.
verses.36:11: For I Myself know the plans that I am planning concerning you, declares the LORD, plans of peace and not for disaster, to give you a future and hope.
verses.36:12: And you will call on Me, and go and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
verses.36:13: And you will search for Me and find Me, when you seek Me with your whole heart.
verses.36:14: And I will be found by you, declares the LORD, and I will restore your fortunes and gather you from all the nations and from all the places to which I have driven you, declares the LORD, and I will bring you back to the place from which I exiled you.
verses.36:15: Because you have said, 'The LORD has raised up prophets for us in Babylon,'
verses.36:21: this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says concerning Ahab son of Kolaiah and concerning Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying falsehood to you in My name: Look, I am giving them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will strike them down before your eyes.
verses.36:22: And from them a curse will be taken up by all the exiles of Judah who are in Babylon, saying, 'May the LORD make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire,'
verses.36:23: because they have committed disgraceful folly in Israel, and have committed adultery with the wives of their neighbors, and have spoken a word falsely in My name that I did not command them; and I am the one who knows and am a witness, declares the LORD."
verses.36:24: And to Shemaiah the Nehelamite you shall speak, saying:
verses.36:25: "This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, has spoken, saying: Because you sent letters in your own name to all the people who are in Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
verses.36:26: 'The LORD has appointed you priest in place of Jehoiada the priest, that there should be overseers in the house of the LORD over every madman who acts as a prophet, so that you put him into the stocks and into the iron collar.
verses.36:27: So now, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who is acting as a prophet to you?
verses.36:28: For on this account he sent to us in Babylon, saying, "It will be long; build houses and dwell in them, and plant gardens and eat their fruit."'"
verses.36:29: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the hearing of Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.36:30: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying:
verses.36:31: "Send to all the exiles, saying, 'This is what the LORD says concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, though I did not send him, and has made you trust in falsehood,
verses.36:32: therefore this is what the LORD says: Look, I am about to punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his seed; he shall not have a man dwelling among this people, and he shall not see the good that I am about to do for My people, declares the LORD, because he has spoken rebellion against the LORD.'"
verses.37:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying:
verses.37:2: "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken, saying: Write for yourself in a scroll all the words that I have spoken to you.
verses.37:3: For look, days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will restore the fortunes of My people Israel and Judah, says the LORD, and I will bring them back to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it."
verses.37:4: Now these are the words that the LORD spoke concerning Israel and concerning Judah:
verses.37:5: For this is what the LORD says: "We have heard a sound of trembling: dread, and there is no peace.
verses.37:6: Ask now and see whether a male gives birth. Why have I seen every strong man with his hands on his loins like a woman giving birth, and all faces turned to paleness?
verses.37:7: Alas! For great is that day, with none like it; and it is a time of trouble for Jacob, yet from it he will be saved.
verses.37:8: And it will happen in that day, declares the LORD of hosts, that I will break his yoke from off your neck and snap your bonds, and foreigners will no longer enslave him;
verses.37:9: instead they will serve the LORD their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them."
verses.37:12: For this is what the LORD says: "Incurable is your fracture, and severe is your wound.
verses.37:13: There is no one to defend your case; for the sore, there are no healing remedies for you.
verses.37:14: All your lovers have forgotten you; they do not seek after you. For I have struck you with the blow of an enemy, with the discipline of a cruel one, because of the abundance of your iniquity, for your sins have grown numerous.
verses.37:16: Therefore all who devour you will be devoured, and all your foes, all of them, will go into captivity; those who despoil you will become spoil, and all who plunder you I will give over as plunder.
verses.37:17: For I will bring healing to you, and of your wounds I will heal you, declares the LORD, because they have called you an outcast: 'She is Zion; there is no one who seeks after her.'"
verses.37:18: This is what the LORD says: "Look, I am about to restore the fortunes of the tents of Jacob, and I will have compassion on his dwelling places; the city will be rebuilt on its mound, and the citadel will stand on its proper site.
verses.37:19: And from them will go forth thanksgiving and the sound of those rejoicing; I will multiply them, and they will not decrease; and I will honor them, and they will not be lowly.
verses.37:20: And his sons will be as in former days, and his assembly will be established before Me, and I will punish all his oppressors.
